Title: Project Manager
Description:
Job Description

Project Manager, Infrastructure (UAE)

Role overview

We are hiring a Project Manager to lead the delivery of infrastructure projects across the UAE, from design coordination through construction handover, on time, within budget and to specification.

**Job title**

Project Manager, Infrastructure

**Department**

Projects / Engineering and Delivery

**Location**

UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah, with regular site visits)

**Reports to**

Projects Director

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Project types**

Roads and bridges, utilities (water, power, drainage), district infrastructure, marine or rail works

Key responsibilitiesPlanning and delivery

* Own the full project lifecycle: scope, programme, budget, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning and handover.

* Develop and maintain the project execution plan, baseline programme (Primavera P6 or MS Project) and work breakdown structure.

* Track progress against milestones, forecast delays early and agree recovery plans.

Cost and commercial control

* Manage the project budget, cash flow, variation orders, claims and final accounts.

* Review and approve contractor and consultant payment applications.

* Report cost forecasts and risks to senior management on a monthly basis.

Stakeholder and contractor management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, main contractors and subcontractors.

* Secure permits and no-objection certificates (NOCs) from UAE authorities such as RTA, DEWA, ADDC, Dubai Municipality, Department of Municipalities and Transport, Etisalat and du.

* Lead progress, design and coordination meetings; resolve interface issues across disciplines.

Quality, health, safety and environment

* Enforce HSE standards in line with UAE regulations, client requirements and ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.

* Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications and quality plans, including inspection and test plans.

* Investigate incidents and non-conformances and close out corrective actions.

Risk and reporting

* Maintain the risk register and run regular risk reviews.

* Issue weekly and monthly progress reports covering programme, cost, quality, safety and risks.

* Lead, mentor and review the performance of the project team.

Qualifications and experienceRequired

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

* 10+ years of experience in infrastructure project delivery, with at least 5 years as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager.

* 5+ years of experience on projects in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of local authority approval processes.

* Proven record of delivering projects above AED 100 million, on time and within budget.

* Experience with FIDIC contracts and claims management.

* Valid UAE driving licence (preferred at hire, required within the probation period).

Preferred

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification.

* Master's degree in Engineering or Project Management.

* Experience with PPP, design-and-build or EPC delivery models.

Skills and competenciesTechnical

* Strong command of civil and infrastructure construction methods, specifications and UAE standards.

* Advanced programming and cost control using Primavera P6, MS Project and Excel.

* Contract administration: extensions of time, variations, claims and dispute avoidance.

* Familiarity with BIM coordination tools and document platforms such as Aconex or Procore.

Leadership and behavioural

* Decisive leader who builds accountable, multidisciplinary teams.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

* Negotiation and conflict resolution with clients, authorities and contractors.

* Sound judgement under pressure, with a strong safety-first mindset.

* Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and on site in UAE summer conditions.

What we offer and how to apply

* Competitive tax-free salary, with the package to be confirmed by the hiring team.

* UAE employment visa, Emirates ID and medical insurance for you and eligible dependants.

* Housing or transport allowance, annual flight ticket and end-of-service gratuity under UAE labour law.

* 30 calendar days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

* Training, certification support and a clear path to Senior Project Manager or Programme Manager.

To apply, send your CV and a cover letter to **admin@adcondxb.ae**

Title: Manager, Client Engagement (1 year contract)
Description:
**Our Company**

BrandActive specializes in the financial analysis, strategy, and logistics of rebrand implementation. Since 1998, we’ve helped many of the world’s most valuable brands plan, budget, and implement brand change—optimizing spend, improving efficiency, and reducing complexity along the way.

  

Our work combines industry-leading analytics with a proven methodology to help clients make smarter decisions, save time and money, and get more value from their brand investments—whether they’re navigating a major rebrand or managing their brand day to day. You can explore examples of our work in our case studies.

  

At BrandActive, we’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive workplace where people can do their best work and grow together. We strive to set the global standard for excellence in our industry while fostering a culture rooted in trust, agility, and growth —guided by our North Star: great people, doing great work, and having a great time doing it.

  

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to a Director, the Manager serves as the project lead and is accountable for strategic planning, project formulation/scoping, scenario planning, cost estimating and relationship management that supports the conversion of the client’s branded assets to a new identity/logo. The Manager then oversees the project as it moves into subsequent implementation and roll-out phases while ensuring that the client’s needs are met.

  

To fulfill these responsibilities, the Manager typically works directly with clients at senior levels of the organization including the C-suite. When conditions safely permit, travel between North America and internationally may be a requirement.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy/Analytics**

* Consult with clients about all elements for project scope and delivery, providing a high-level of expertise and instilling confidence in the client.
* Work with the client and BrandActive’s team to define the scope of brand transition across all branded asset categories (e.g. signage, ID badges, website, etc.)
* Develop several high-level scenarios to achieve brand launch and completion objectives using cost, time, quality and impact as the key variables.
* Provide senior leadership and their Board the information they need to make fiscally responsible brand decisions.
* Establish high-level transition strategies by branded asset category with priority given to those categories which are required for brand launch and have longer lead times.
* Formulate and comprehend overall implementation financials and to evaluate the implications of alternative strategy approaches on these financials at a macro and micro level.
* Develop cost estimates based on developed transition strategies.
* Define the high-level processes required to support an efficient implementation process.
* Create a high-level project communications plan to ensure engagement of all project constituents.
* Define the project organization required to execute the brand transition in a way that ensures achievement of client goals and desired outcomes.

  

**Project Management**

* Lead the project team, allocating and utilizing resources in an efficient manner and maintaining a co-operative, motivated and successful team.
* Communicate project status regularly (e.g. using dashboard reports) and escalate issues to stakeholders, sponsor(s), and senior leadership as required.
* Manage project deliverables in line with approved project plans.
* Manage or coordinate partners and work groups engaged in project delivery.
* Lead internal projects and client-facing (or conference call) meetings.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans (following PMI methodologies).
* Record, track and manage project issues and risks, escalating concerns when necessary.
* Manage project scope and change control.
* Monitor project progress and performance.
* Monitor the project budget.
* Create and present deliverables, and facilitate approval of recommendations.
* Review and provide guidance with new statements of work with current projects.
* Manage the creation of change orders with direction from the Director.

  

**Professional Development**

* Own your growth by setting and updating development goals, actively seeking feedback, and aligning your aspirations with business goals.
* Contribute to internal initiatives that impact the client and/or team member experience such as our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Advisory Committee, Community Impact Committee, or our Social Committee.
* Bring forward smarter, faster, better solutions to processes and identify opportunities to be more agile in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate inclusive and supportive behavior, contributing to BrandActive’s core values of trust, agility, and growth, commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion, (EDI), humanity, and wellbeing.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

You might not tick every box, but if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we’d love to hear from you. We value potential, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

  

**Education and Experience**

* Demonstrated commitment to life-long learning; post-secondary degree, diploma or certificate preferred.
* Three to four years of project management experience with at least two years as the Project Lead (managing projects from start to finish).
* Strong consultative skills gained through experience working as an internal consultant or in a professional services environment.

  

**Competencies**

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Superior organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity including the ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure across more complex/multi-faceted projects.
* Presence including the ability and confidence to manage client calls.
* Proven credibility gained by consistently delivering on commitments.
* Demonstrated ability move across a range of projects and clients over time.
* Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships both internally and externally.
* Excellent client contact, negotiation and problem-resolution skills.
* Detail-oriented, including the ability to identify important details, ensuring things are not overlooked and delivering a consistently high quality of work, keeping the overall goals of the project in mind.
* Demonstrated initiative including finding innovative solutions for the company and the clients.
* Skill in managing the relationship with the client and looking for additional opportunities to bring value and provide additional services.
* Taking action to make the most of the opportunities for the good of the company; takes a long-term view with the client.
* Leadership skills to lead a team of diverse individuals, providing oversight of their work, coaching and supporting them from a developmental perspective.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Excellent computer skills including MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project or other scheduling software such as Smartsheet or Teamwork Projects.
* At least basic knowledge and experience with MS Visio.
* Additional languages an asset.

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

BrandActive offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including:

* **Competitive compensation:** $100,000.00 -$150,000.00 CAD. Total compensation depends on experience, education, and skills and includes non-cash rewards. This range is plus commission.
* **Values led culture** focused on humanity, trust, agility, and growth. Check out our **Culture Statement.**
* **Comprehensive health and dental coverage** with no waiting period – your benefits start on day one.
* **Generous paid time off:** 3 weeks of vacation, additional office closures, Flex Fridays, and extended long weekends throughout the summer.
* **Holistic wellbeing benefits,** including a wellbeing allowance, flexible additional time off to care for a loved one, support mental health, or observe meaningful religious or cultural holidays.
* **Parental leave benefits** to support you and your family.
* **Home office and communications reimbursement** to help you work comfortably.
* **Charitable donation matching** to support the causes that matter to you.
* **Flexible work options** – Hybrid - with adaptable schedules.
* **Two annual town halls** in Toronto, featuring engaging sessions and fun team activities.
* **Supportive leadership and career development**, with ongoing coaching and feedback to help you grow and succeed, quarterly formal feedback, annual performance reviews and separate annual development meetings.
* **Work-from-anywhere flexibility,** with the option to work abroad for up to four weeks (in eligible countries and after a minimum tenure depending on the role and circumstance).
* And more!

  

**Start Date**

Immediately.

  

**Location**

Hybrid -Toronto, Ontario. BrandActive has an office in Toronto, ON.

  

**Job Vacancy:** This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope.

  

**Commitment to Equal Opportunity**

BrandActive is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values inclusion in its workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.

  

**Accessibility Statement**

BrandActive is dedicated to ensuring an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations during the application process, please let the Talent Manager know. We are committed to partnering with you to provide support and make reasonable adjustments throughout the process. All information received in relation to accommodation will be kept confidential and will be handled in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act.

  

**The Interview Process**

At BrandActive, we use AI within our recruitment process in the following ways: screening applicants and recording calls and interviews. All candidates will be notified of the use of AI at the start of a call or interview and can request to opt out. As part of our broader dedication to EDI, we continuously review and refine our use of AI to support equitable experiences for all applicants.

* **Initial Call (Pre-Screen):** If your application is selected, you will have a prescreen call with the Talent Manager where we will use AI to transcribe for accurate note taking.
* **Virtual Interview:** Followed by an interview with the hiring manager.
* **Case Presentation Interview:** The last step is a case study and presentation to our team.

  

We thank all applicants for their interest in BrandActive, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Senior Solution Architect - Core Networks
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
At Capgemini Engineering, we are shaping the future of mission-critical connectivity across the globe. Our Connectivity & Network Engineering teams are at the heart of next-generation telecom transformation, delivering resilient, secure, and scalable core network platforms for some of the most demanding environments in the world. In Al-Khobar, we are growing our team of senior technical leaders who can own architecture decisions, drive multi-vendor integration, and lead high-performing engineering teams. If you are a seasoned core network architect who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and strategic leadership, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional
**Lead Core Network Architect**
to own the architecture and technical leadership of mobile core networks for private mission-critical connectivity platforms. You will define end-to-end core architecture strategies, lead complex multi-vendor integrations, and serve as the principal technical authority across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains — ensuring every solution is resilient, scalable, and built to the highest standards of carrier-grade reliability.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Architecting and owning end-to-end mobile core network solutions across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains, including subscriber management, policy and charging frameworks, and gateway functions, ensuring carrier-grade resilience and scalability for mission-critical private network environments
* Defining comprehensive core network architecture strategies including capacity planning, redundancy models, and geo-resilience designs, translating complex SLA requirements into robust, future-proof technical solutions that meet the highest standards of availability and performance
* Leading multi-vendor integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains, managing technical interdependencies and ensuring seamless end-to-end interoperability across the full network stack in large-scale deployment programs
* Producing high-quality High Level Design (HLD) and Low Level Design (LLD) documentation, operational runbooks, and technical reference architectures, ensuring that all solutions are thoroughly documented and ready for operational handover
* Driving vendor technical and relationship management, acting as the primary technical interface with key technology partners, evaluating vendor capabilities, influencing roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with program objectives and customer requirements
* Leading customer engagement activities at a senior technical level, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, presenting architectural recommendations with clarity and confidence, and translating complex technical concepts into business-aligned outcomes
* Managing and mentoring the core network engineering team, providing technical guidance, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, and developing the next generation of core network talent within the organization
* Supporting deployment, performance optimization, and acceptance activities, providing hands-on technical leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure every solution meets design intent, performance benchmarks, and operational readiness criteria

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a technically exceptional and strategically minded core network leader who brings deep domain expertise, proven delivery experience, and the gravitas to lead in complex, high-stakes environments.
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in telecom core network architecture, with a strong and demonstrable background in mission-critical network environments and a proven track record of leading large-scale, complex core network programs from architecture through to deployment
* Deep technical expertise across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS technologies, including thorough knowledge of subscriber management, policy and charging systems, gateway functions, and the end-to-end mobile core architecture in both standalone and non-standalone 5G configurations
* Extensive experience leading large-scale, multi-vendor core network deployments, with the ability to manage complex technical interdependencies, drive vendor alignment, and ensure seamless integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains
* Strong proficiency in IP networking, routing protocols, and security controls, with the ability to design and validate transport and security architectures that underpin mission-critical core network platforms with uncompromising reliability
* Demonstrated ability to translate SLA requirements into robust technical solutions, with experience producing HLD/LLD documentation, operational runbooks, and capacity and geo-resilience strategies for carrier-grade network environments
* Proven senior stakeholder management and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex technical strategies with clarity and authority
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with experience building, guiding, and mentoring core network engineering teams in fast-paced, multicultural, and high-pressure delivery environments
* Experience working in or with KSA-based telecom operators or service providers is highly advantageous, with familiarity of the regional deployment landscape, operational expectations, and the strategic connectivity priorities aligned to Vision 2030

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* Career acceleration programs — From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise.
* Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services — Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.
* Dedicated innovation labs — We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum.
* Engineering Horizons — A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes center stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

Title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead - Damascus Based
Description:
**Position Objective:**

Define and govern the NOC operating model, ensuring all front-office monitoring and L1 support functions across the fiber network, Core, IT (ITOC), and IXP domains are fully designed, staffed, tooled, and validated ahead of Day-1 launch. Post-launch, the role transitions to governing the MSP NOC function.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

Define the NOC operating model —structure, monitoring scope, support processes, shift model, and escalation matrix.

Define monitoring requirements — latency, jitter, packet loss, and availability thresholds triggering alarms, auto-tickets, and escalation.

Define fault management framework — alarm handling/correlation, fault classification, prioritization, ticket creation, TAC escalation, threshold requirements across all monitored domains.

Define the NOC interface to the change management process — planned maintenance visibility, change freeze enforcement, and network change impact monitoring.

Define NOC tooling requirements including OSS, NMS, EMS, monitoring platforms, and real-time dashboard specifications.

Define the interface model between the NOC, TAC, field teams, SecOC, Application Services, and MSPs.

Define NOC procedures for carrier peering and interconnection monitoring across international exchange points and subsea landing stations.

Define NOC KPIs, SLA requirements, and performance reporting framework.

Define staffing levels, skills requirements, and training framework for NOC operators across all domains.

Govern NOC readiness validation — oversee simulations, dry runs, and acceptance criteria sign-off.

Participate in cross-functional OAT (Operational Acceptance Testing) to validate end-to-end NOC readiness for Day-1 launch.

Define the IXP operating model — route server management procedures, peering policy governance, BGP fault handling, and member onboarding interface with the NOC.

**Qualifications & Experience**
:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline.

Minimum 10 years in telecommunications network operations, with significant NOC leadership experience.

Strong experience designing or leading a NOC function in a carrier or wholesale infrastructure environment.

Experience defining alarm management frameworks and NOC tooling requirements across converged network and IT environments.

Greenfield or build-to-operate program experience is preferred.

Strong knowledge of NOC operations, monitoring methodologies, and alarm management across network and IT domains.

Experience with IXP operations including route server management, BGP monitoring, and peering policy governance.

Familiarity with NMS/EMS platforms, IT monitoring tools, and ITSM systems.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

Experience with MSP governance, vendor performance management, and continual service improvement in NOC operations.

Title: Infrastructure and Track Manager (Metro & Tram)
Description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure & Track Manager to oversee the maintenance, reliability and lifecycle performance of tram infrastructure and track assets.

This position will lead the delivery of maintenance activities across power supply systems, track infrastructure and associated civil assets, ensuring operational availability, safety, reliability and cost efficiency. The successful candidate will take ownership of maintenance planning, team performance, asset optimisation and continuous improvement, working closely with operations, engineering teams, contractors and other stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee maintenance activities across tram infrastructure, including track, traction power supply, substations, drainage, stations, depots, tunnels, bridges, elevated structures and associated civil assets.
* Ensure maintenance programmes are effectively planned and delivered in line with operational requirements, asset reliability targets and agreed performance standards.
* Monitor asset condition and performance, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, minimise service disruptions and optimise lifecycle costs.
* Manage maintenance resources, including workforce allocation, technical services, equipment, spare parts and materials.
* Provide leadership and technical direction during infrastructure incidents and emergencies, including participation in a 24-hour on-call management structure.
* Lead, coach and develop the infrastructure and track maintenance team, ensuring appropriate technical competencies and performance standards.
* Manage maintenance budgets, monitor expenditure and identify opportunities for operational efficiencies and cost optimisation.
* Oversee maintenance documentation, technical procedures and asset management records, ensuring accurate reporting and effective use of maintenance management systems.
* Work collaboratively with operations, engineering, contractors, client representatives and other stakeholders to ensure effective maintenance delivery.
* Ensure compliance with railway safety standards, HSE requirements, environmental procedures and relevant asset management practices.
* Support asset lifecycle planning, including major repairs, overhauls, replacement strategies and obsolescence management.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline.
* Professional membership of a recognised engineering institution is preferred/required.
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in railway infrastructure and track maintenance, with at least 4 years in a supervisory or management position.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing tram or railway infrastructure maintenance, particularly track and power supply systems.
* Strong understanding of railway infrastructure operations, maintenance practices and safety requirements.
* Experience managing maintenance programmes, asset management systems, maintenance budgets and resource planning.
* Proven ability to lead technical teams, manage contractors and coordinate with multiple operational stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, particularly in time-sensitive operational and emergency situations.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

**What We Are Looking For**

A hands-on infrastructure and maintenance leader with a strong railway background, capable of driving asset reliability, leading technical teams and ensuring the safe and efficient performance of tram infrastructure throughout its operational lifecycle.

The role will provide an independent and objective view of operational quality by assessing adherence to established standards, identifying root causes of defects and control failures, monitoring effectiveness of corrective actions, and providing actionable insights to leadership.

Title: Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing
Description:
We seek an individual inspired by our mission, whose beliefs align with our core values of integrity, inquiry, compassion and courage, and who reflects our core competencies to join our Upper School as **Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing** beginning in August 2027. This is a full-time position.

Salary range: $124,000 to $165,000. The total compensation for this Assistant Head position is based on placement on the Havergal College faculty grid plus a $20,000 leadership stipend (included in the above salary range). Grid placement is determined by teaching qualifications and experience up to a maximum of 11 years. Final placement within the range is based on the successful candidate's credentials and years of experience.

**Why Teach with Us**

At Havergal College, we believe that our strength lies in our faculty and staff's collective efforts, talents, and accomplishments. Together, we can make a positive and lasting impact on our students' lives.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package for teachers, including a faculty teaching grid that is well above the major urban school boards; contributions to and participation in the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan and/or Group RSP; generous holidays that allow employees to recharge; comprehensive health and dental benefits; support for professional development including support for graduate work, additional qualifications (AQs), faculty-wide and individual professional development in teaching and learning, wellbeing, equity and inclusion, assessment, and experiential education; and teaching on a beautiful 22-acre campus with excellent facilities.

**Why Havergal is the Place to Be**

Founded in 1894 and located on a beautiful 22-acre campus in midtown Toronto, Canada, Havergal College is one of Canada’s pre-eminent independent schools for girls from Junior Kindergarten through Grade 12.

At Havergal College, we believe great schools are made up of great people. With a rich history spanning over 130 years, we are committed to offering a contemporary liberal arts education rooted in the Anglican tradition. Our mission is to prepare young women to make a difference. Through our outstanding academic and co-curricular programs and a cohesive, collegial team of faculty and administrative staff, we nurture a culture of capability that fosters self-confidence, leadership, critical thinking, and global-mindedness in our students.

We take pride in attracting and retaining highly qualified faculty and administrative staff to ensure our school remains at the forefront of educational excellence. Join us in this transformative education journey, working together to empower young women to make a positive difference in our world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that an inclusive environment fosters a culture of mutual respect, creativity and innovation, collaboration and accountability. To this end, we encourage applications from all qualified candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives, including women, BIPOC (Black, Indigenous and People of Colour) peoples, LGBTQ2S+, and persons with disabilities to join our thriving team. We seek candidates committed to nurturing a community where integrity, compassion, inquiry and courage thrive.

**The Position:**

The Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing provides operational leadership for student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12. Working collaboratively with the Upper School Leadership Team, this role ensures that every student is known, valued, and cared for, and has access to the relationships, resources, and support necessary to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing oversees the integrated work of Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role. Through the leadership and development of these teams, the Assistant Head establishes a coordinated and responsive approach to student support that promotes belonging, engagement, inclusion and student success.

Guided by Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing, the Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing leads proactive and preventative approaches to wellbeing across the Upper School, building the capacity of faculty and staff to support students and ensuring effective systems are in place to identify and respond to emerging student needs.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing reports directly to the Head of Upper School and is accountable for fostering a safe, equitable and inclusive school culture aligned with Havergal's mission and values. This is a faculty leadership position requiring teaching qualifications and experience in an educational setting.

**Specific Accountabilities:**

**Leadership of Student Support & Wellbeing**

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of a comprehensive, coordinated approach to student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12, aligned with Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing.
* Champion proactive, preventative, strengths-based and evidence-informed approaches to wellbeing that promote student belonging, resilience, engagement and healthy development.
* Identify emerging trends in student wellbeing and learning needs, using relevant data, research and professional expertise to inform priorities, programming and resource allocation.
* Partner with the Assistant Heads of Middle and Senior Divisions and the Director of Boarding to ensure that wellbeing priorities are meaningfully embedded in the student experience, including Form, Teacher Advisor, grade-level and Boarding programming.
* Build faculty and staff capacity through professional learning and shared practices that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive education and effective responses to student needs.
* Contribute to school-wide strategic initiatives that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive excellence and the overall student experience.

**Leadership and Oversight of Student Support Services**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role.
* Lead, coach and develop Student Support leaders and team members, fostering professional growth, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities and communication practices across Student Support services to ensure an integrated and effective approach to student care.
* Oversee the effective allocation of staffing, resources and budgets across Student Support services.
* Ensure the effective delivery and continuous improvement of student support services, promoting responsive, accessible and coordinated support that meets the evolving needs of students and families.
* Provide leadership for Learning Support practices, ensuring effective systems for accommodations, Individual Education Plans and appropriate academic interventions.
* Champion the development of executive functioning skills, learning strategies and student self-advocacy in collaboration with academic leaders and faculty.
* Promote effective transitions for students entering, moving through and graduating from the Upper School, with particular attention to students requiring additional support.

**Coordinated Student Care and Intervention**

* Lead the development and implementation of effective systems for identifying, assessing, supporting and monitoring students experiencing academic, social, emotional, behavioural or health-related challenges.
* Oversee the Upper School Student Support Team, ensuring effective multidisciplinary collaboration, clear processes for case management and appropriate follow-through.
* Establish consistent protocols for student referrals, documentation, communication, intervention planning and escalation of concerns.
* Provide leadership and consultation in complex student support matters, working closely with Student Support professionals, divisional Assistant Heads and the Head of Upper School.
* Ensure that student support planning reflects appropriate professional expertise, confidentiality, safeguarding responsibilities and relevant school policies.
* Partner with families and external professionals, as appropriate, to coordinate student care and support successful school engagement.
* Oversee processes for student re-entry and reintegration following health-related leaves or other circumstances requiring coordinated support.

**Collaborative and Engaged Member of the Upper School Leadership Team**

* Serve as an active member of the Upper School Leadership Team, collaborating with divisional Assistant Heads, the Director of Boarding, Academic Leadership and Student Life leaders to advance shared priorities for student learning, wellbeing and engagement.
* Provide advice to the Head of Upper School on emerging student support needs, complex cases, resource priorities and opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the ongoing review and development of relevant school policies, procedures, the Family Handbook and communications relating to student support and wellbeing.
* Support Admissions in reviewing prospective applicants with IEPs or social-emotional needs.

**Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience**

* A recognized teaching qualification and membership in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or equivalent qualifications and eligibility for OCT certification.
* Demonstrated teaching experience in a school setting, preferably with students in Grades 7–12.
* Experience in educational leadership, student support, Guidance, Learning Support or a related area of school-based practice.
* Deep understanding of the developmental, academic, social and emotional needs of students in Grades 7–12.
* Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary approaches to student wellbeing, mental health promotion, inclusive education and coordinated student support.
* Familiarity with the priorities and contemporary approaches within a girls' school.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary teams and foster a collaborative, accountable team culture.
* Sound professional judgement, discretion and problem-solving ability, particularly in navigating complex and sensitive student and family matters.
* Strong understanding of safeguarding, confidentiality, professional boundaries and appropriate student support and intervention practices.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships, think strategically and manage competing priorities.
* Leadership qualifications are an asset.
* Demonstrated ability and commitment to the Core & Leadership Competencies of:
  + Inclusive Excellence
  + Collaboration & Teamwork
  + Integrity & Trust
  + Learning Agility
  + Communication
  + Growth Mindset
  + Coach & Develop Others

Title: Assistant Director
Description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Assistant Director partners with the Director of Operations to lead all aspects of the Food and Nutrition Services Department within a healthcare facility. This role is accountable for strong day-to-day operations and for helping create and sustain a culture of hospitality and patient-centered care across the healthcare campus. The Assistant Director leads by example, keeps the department organized and running smoothly, and drives initiatives that improve patient, employee and client satisfaction. In the Director’s absence, the Assistant Director assumes departmental leadership.

This position is ideal for a proven people leader with exceptional organizational skills who has managed teams that include multiple managers.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Patient-Centered Care (Patient Services Manager and Clinical Team)**

* Support patient safety by ensuring HACCP plans and QA checks are completed as directed.
* Conduct daily patient rounding with patients and nursing staff; document findings, communicate them and follow issues through to resolution.
* Ensure core competency of teams by coordinating educational sessions and annual reviews, holding the Daily Spark huddle and completing the monthly in-service.

### **Culinary Experience (Executive Chef and Culinary Team)**

* Ensure great food is prepared and served daily on all shifts, in line with the Culinour food philosophy.
* Keep production systems engaged to deliver outstanding food quality and presentation.
* Partner with the Executive Chef on menu execution, production planning and cost control.

### **Retail and Catering (Retail Manager and Hospitality Team)**

* Ensure food is packaged with care and carries accurate labeling and information.
* Verify that POS systems are programmed accurately and appropriately.
* Ensure every guest is greeted with a smile and recognition.
* Ensure locations are set up for guest ease and convey a sense of wellbeing.

### **Staff Education and Leadership (Leadership Team)**

* Ensure the team is trained in hospitality and job-specific competencies.
* Hold the team accountable for job flows and accurate time punches.
* Ensure all training is documented and development plans are in place.
* Build a culture of hospitality and teamwork in which no job is harder or better than any other.
* Coach, mentor and evaluate managers and supervisors, and support recruitment, onboarding and retention.

### **Quality Compliance and Complaint Resolution (Leadership Team)**

* Report on facility QA projects and results.
* Help ensure the department meets requirements set by CMS, The Joint Commission or similar accrediting body, the local health department and the State Department of Health.
* Resolve patient, employee and client complaints promptly and document outcomes.

### **Operations and Administration**

* Assist the Director in all aspects of departmental management, including scheduling, labor and budget oversight, purchasing and inventory.
* Use data and reporting to track performance, identify trends and drive improvement.
* Manage projects and follow-up on cross-functional initiatives to completion.

* Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive cultural change.

---------------------

* Empathy, compassion and hospitality
* Strategic thinking and adaptability
* Ability to hold productive conversations with team members
* Commitment to patient-centered care

Title: Night Duty Assistant Front Office Manager
Description:
Job Description – Night Duty Assistant Manager

Department: Front Office  
Reports To: Front Office Manager / Rooms Division Manager / Hotel Manager  
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall hotel operations during the night shift, ensuring smooth and efficient service delivery, guest satisfaction, safety, security, and compliance with hotel standards and company policies.

The role serves as the senior management representative on duty during nighttime hours, handling guest concerns, managing operational issues, supervising night staff, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently in the absence of daytime management.

Key Responsibilities1. Hotel Operations Management

* Ensure proper handover from the evening team to the morning team.
* Make operational decisions in the absence of senior management.

2. Guest Relations and Customer Service

* Welcome VIP guests and ensure special attention is provided where required.
* Handle guest complaints, requests, and service recovery professionally.
* Ensure high levels of guest satisfaction throughout the night.
* Follow up on unresolved guest issues and ensure appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain a visible management presence in the hotel.

3. Front Office and Night Audit

* Supervise night reception and front office activities.
* Ensure smooth check-in and check-out procedures.
* Monitor room availability, occupancy, room status, and arrivals.
* Ensure the night audit is completed accurately and on time.
* Review daily reports, financial transactions, and operational discrepancies.
* Ensure proper cash handling and compliance with financial procedures.
* Process Front Office Duty Roster and other Front Office related works

4. Security and Safety

* Ensure the safety and security of guests, employees, and hotel property.
* Conduct regular security and safety inspections.
* Monitor incidents, unusual activities, and emergency situations.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety, health and safety, and emergency procedures.
* Act as the incident coordinator during emergencies until the relevant senior management or emergency services take over.
* Complete incident reports and escalate serious matters immediately.

5. Team Management and Supervision

* Supervise and support all employees working during the night shift.
* Ensure adequate staffing and effective allocation of duties.
* Monitor employee attendance, grooming, conduct, and performance.
* Motivate team members and maintain a professional working environment.
* Address operational and staff-related issues appropriately.
* Ensure proper communication and handover between shifts.

6. Financial and Administrative Responsibilities

* Monitor overnight revenue and financial transactions.
* Ensure accurate completion of daily revenue and night audit reports.
* Investigate discrepancies and report irregularities.
* Ensure compliance with company financial controls and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, guest complaints, and operational activities.

7. Reporting and Communication

* Prepare and submit the Night Manager's Daily Report.
* Communicate important operational updates to the Hotel Manager and relevant department heads.
* Highlight maintenance issues, guest concerns, security incidents, and outstanding matters.
* Ensure a detailed handover to the morning management team.

Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in hospitality management, Hotel Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in hotel operations, preferably in a supervisory or management position.
* Previous experience as a Duty Manager, Night Manager, or Assistant Front Office Manager is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of front office operations, night audit, and hotel management systems.
* Knowledge of hotel health, safety, security, and emergency procedures.
* Experience in handling guest complaints and managing operational challenges.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent guest relations and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and hotel PMS systems.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Night Duty Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Guest satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Smooth and efficient overnight hotel operations.
* Accuracy and timely completion of night audit.
* Compliance with company policies and operational standards.
* Security, safety, and incident management.
* Staff supervision and performance.
* Quality of daily reports and shift handovers.
* Reduction of operational errors and financial discrepancies.

Authority and Accountability

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is authorized to:

* Make operational decisions during the night shift.
* Handle guest complaints and approve service recovery within company guidelines.
* Coordinate all departments and allocate available resources.
* Take immediate action in emergency situations.
* Escalate major financial, security, guest-related, or operational matters to senior management.

Overall Accountability: To ensure the hotel front office operates safely, efficiently, and professionally throughout the night, while maintaining the company's service standards, protecting its assets, and delivering an excellent guest experience.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED3,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Customer Service Manager
Description:

At Farmers Depot, providing an exceptional customer experience is at the heart of what we do. We're looking for a **Customer Service Manager** who is passionate about building strong customer relationships, developing people and finding better ways to work.

  

In this role, you'll lead and support our Customer Service team, ensuring our customers receive timely, knowledgeable and reliable service. You'll play an important role in shaping the department's processes, setting performance expectations and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen customer relationships and support business growth.

  

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll take the time to understand our customers, systems and processes firsthand so you can effectively support the team and lead continuous improvement.

**Working with us:**

Our Customer Service team serves customers Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:30pm. Your regular working hours will be Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, with a one-hour unpaid lunch break.

  

As the Customer Service Manager, you'll be responsible for ensuring the department is appropriately staffed and equipped to serve customers throughout core business hours. Occasional work outside standard hours, including weekends, may be required to meet business needs.

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

**Customer Service Leadership**

* Assess team structure, responsibilities, workflows and operational challenges to identify opportunities for improvement.

* Identify recurring customer issues and implement corrective actions to prevent them from happening again.
* Establish and support consistent processes for managing escalated customer concerns.
* Work collaboratively with other departments to improve communication, coordination and the overall customer experience.
* Use operational data, KPIs and customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and service levels.
* Establish and monitor the administration of phone-based marketing and sales campaigns.
* Support cross-departmental managers and product teams in representing products and providing support to producers.

  

**Team Development & Continuous Improvement**

  

* Assess the current capabilities, responsibilities and development needs of the Customer Service team.
* Establish clear role expectations and responsibilities across the department.
* Identify training requirements and implement appropriate development plans.
* Develop processes, procedures and documentation that support consistent and effective departmental operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, collaboration and sales growth.

  

**Your background includes:**

  

* Post-secondary education in Business Administration or a related field is preferred.
* At least 5 years of experience in a customer service role, providing direct customer support.
* At least 3 years of experience leading, coaching and mentoring a team.
* The ability to think strategically while remaining comfortable getting involved in day-to-day operations.
* Strong customer relationship skills and a professional, client-facing presence.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and negotiation skills.
* The ability to manage competing priorities, multitask and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of customer service software, databases and tools; experience with Shopify is an asset.
* Technologically savvy with proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.
* Experience in the agriculture industry is an asset.
* Fluency in both English and French is considered an asset.

  

**Why work with us:**

  

* Canadian Family-Owned and Operated Company
* Competitive wages
* Extended health and dental benefits
* RRSP matching program
* Profit sharing bonus
* Donation matching program
* Professional development opportunities
* Store discount at Valley Feeds
* Be part of a company that values integrity, innovation, and giving back.

  

**Living our values:**

We’re a family-owned business that values its people and the communities we serve. We are committed to providing a supportive and respectful workplace, offering competitive compensation and benefits, and investing in our employees’ success. Whether through our work with customers, our support of employees, or our community involvement, we strive to live our values every day.

  

* **Passion:** Serving customers innovatively and well.

10–15+ years in banking IT, of which 7+ years hands-on with Eximbills

Full-time, on-site

Must-have qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or Finance.
* 7+ years hands-on with
  **Eximbills Enterprise (EE) and Customer Enterprise (CE)**
  : configuration, customization and support, from either the vendor/implementation side or a bank’s IT team.
* At least one full Eximbills implementation, migration or major upgrade delivered to go-live.
* Deep knowledge of trade finance products and ICC rules (UCP 600, ISBP, URDG 758, URC 522).
* Strong SWIFT trade messaging knowledge (MT7xx, MT4xx, MT798).
* Integration experience: MQ, ESB, web services/APIs, file interfaces with core banking.
* Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Working knowledge of Java/J2EE and application servers (WebSphere/WebLogic) used by Eximbills.
* Full SDLC ownership: BRD, FSD, SIT, UAT, go-live and post-production support.
* GCC banking experience.

**Functional and business partnering**

1. Act as the trade finance subject-matter expert for Transaction Banking, Trade Operations, Compliance and Credit.
2. Run requirement workshops and write BRDs, FSDs, user stories and process flows for import/export LCs, standby LCs, guarantees (LGs), documentary collections, bills discounting, trade loans and shipping guarantees.
3. Design and support Shariah-compliant trade products (e.g., Murabaha-based import financing) with the Shariah and product teams.
4. Translate ICC rules (UCP 600, ISBP 821, eUCP, URDG 758, URC 522, URR 725, ISP98) and SAMA requirements into system rules, checks and workflows.

**Technical and platform ownership**

1. Own Eximbills EE/CE configuration and customization: products, workflows, fee and charge setup, limits, accounting entries, advices and reports.
2. Design and govern integrations between Eximbills and core banking, limits/credit, GL, customer and corporate channels, SWIFT, sanctions screening and AML, and document/workflow systems, using MQ, ESB (e.g., IBM IIB/ACE), REST/SOAP APIs and batch file interfaces.
3. Own SWIFT trade messaging: MT7xx (LC/guarantee), MT4xx (collections), MT798 corporate-to-bank, and related MT/MX payment messages, including annual SWIFT Standards Release impact and ISO 20022 readiness.
4. Write and review Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for data fixes, reconciliations, MIS and regulatory reporting; tune performance.
5. Lead version upgrades, patches and environment builds (DEV, SIT, UAT, pre-prod, prod, DR) with infrastructure and the vendor.
6. Evaluate and help deliver roadmap items: Eximbills Microservices/cloud, digital trade, supply chain finance platform integration, trade-based money laundering (TBML) controls, vessel and shipment checks.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree, College diploma, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience:** 1+ years in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, or B2B Client Engagement within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or Cloud software (candidates with 1+ years in a high-volume, scaled CS motion demonstrating exceptional commercial results are strongly considered).
* **Domain Knowledge:** Demonstrated working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals, compliance workflows, and practice management operations.
* **Portfolio Management at Scale:** Proven track record managing a large book of business (150+ accounts) using smart prioritization, automated triggers, and digital leverage rather than unsustainable blanket high-touch.
* **Commercial Track Record:** Demonstrated success in driving product adoption, expanding recurring revenue (ARR/NRR), and safeguarding retention within a matrixed enterprise organization.
* **Tooling & Data Literacy:** Proficiency with enterprise CRM and CS tooling (Salesforce, ChurnZero, Gainsight) and analytics platforms; adept at interpreting health scores, telemetry data, and task queues to guide daily outreach.
* **Bilingual Communication preferred (Canada Hires):** Exceptional professional verbal and written communication skills in both English and French (minimum CEFR C1 proficiency required).

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Balances consultative advocacy with strong commercial instincts to identify cross-sell opportunities, run business reviews, and articulate ROI to firm owners.
* **Data-Driven Prioritization:** Ability to filter signal from noise across large datasets to invest high-touch effort where it drives maximum retention and growth impact.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Skilled at motivating external partner principals to adopt new workflows while coordinating internal cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support, Approvals) to resolve blockers.
* **Accountability & Resilience:** Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ownership over commercial outcomes; maintains composure, focus, and empathy under high-volume demands.
* **Adaptive & Solution-Oriented Communication:** Smoothly transitions between strategic advisory conversations with firm leaders and practical, technical workflow troubleshooting with operational staff.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Accounting Certifications:** Foundational qualification in accounting or bookkeeping (e.g., CPA, CA, CFA, ACCA, ICB, CIPP) or official ProAdvisor certification.
* **Platform Experience:** Hands-on experience with QuickBooks, Float, Xero, or comparable financial management, spend management, and ERP software ecosystems.
* **Scaled CS Methodology:** Direct experience in pooled, digital-first, or automated customer success delivery models within global BPO or high-growth tech environments.

**Benefits & Perks**

Title: Senior Food Programs Manager
Description:
**ABOUT BEZOS ACADEMY**

At Bezos Academy, we believe all children deserve the great start that excellent early education provides, including in under-resourced communities. Our mission is to nurture the potential in every child to become a creative leader, original thinker, and lifelong learner by inventing the solutions needed to scale early childhood education. We are a unique organization that realizes our mission in two ways. First, we operate a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families. Second, we create tools, products, technology, and other solutions designed to reach young children and their caregivers well beyond the walls of our schools. We aspire to have a profound, large-scale impact on children ages zero to five.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As the Senior Food Programs Manager at Bezos Academy, you will own the design, execution, and ongoing improvement of our multi-state preschool network's food programs spanning onsite food preparation, vendor-provided service, and funding through the federal Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP). In this role, you will ensure all students are nourished through a compliant, scalable, and financially optimized program that generates meaningful reimbursement revenue across the network whether the preschool is using vendor-supplied meals and snacks or cooking food from scratch on site. You will set up the metrics by which meal quality, food safety, and cost are measured and help develop training so school staff deliver strong results. You will lead improvements, from vendor procurement to new site launches, that keep food service standardized, compliant, and cost-effective as the network matures. You bring to this role the judgment to balance nutrition, compliance, and cost without compromising on any of them, and the operational rigor to ensure that every child in a Bezos Academy classroom eats nutritional high-quality food across states and sites.

**LOCATION**

* Arizona, Florida, Kentucky, Texas, or Washington and within two hours' drive to multiple Bezos Academy preschools (please see our website for school locations); Seattle, WA preferred.
* Relocation support is available for those willing to relocate to Seattle, WA.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, exempt (salaried) position.
* **The full salary range for this position, across all applicable United States geographies, is $113,000 - $216,000 per year.** The upper portion of the salary range is typically reserved for employees who have been in the role for multiple years and have demonstrated strong performance over time. Starting salary will vary by location, qualifications, and prior experience; during the interview process, candidates will learn the starting salary range applicable for their location.
* This role includes 15 paid days of vacation, 4 days of paid personal time off, 9 paid days of sick (care) time, 9 paid holidays, 5 paid days off for an organization-wide winter break, and additional time off if required by applicable law. Benefits for this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match, paid parental leave, an employer-matched flexible spending account for dependent care, and more. Please see here for details.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Eight or more years of relevant experience, including five or more years of experience in project or program management
* Expertise in food programs for schools or other child-centered settings, including knowledge of early childhood nutritional requirements and regulations (USDA Child & Adult Care Food Program, National School Lunch Program, etc.)
* Track record of delivering results through end-to-end program management (e.g., building, executing, monitoring, and continuously improving programs and initiatives)
* Demonstrated success in project management and related data collection, including the ability to utilize project management software to handle multiple complex projects, track progress, and communicate updates to key stakeholders
* Valid state driver's license, clean motor vehicle records, personal auto insurance (at least minimum coverage under applicable law), and access to a reliable vehicle
* Ability to travel to schools or attend team meetings up to 40% of the time depending on business needs

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with managing food program operations across multiple states, relevant solution development and implementation, and end-to-end product delivery
* Experience evaluating operational feasibility and implementation impact, including assessing burden, workflow implications, and trade-offs
* Proven ability to translate complex requirements into clear, concise, and usable expectations
* Proficiency in one or more project management methodologies (such as Six Sigma, Agile, etc.) or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* National food safety certification (issued by the National Registry of Food Safety Professionals, ServSafe, or the National Restaurant Association Education Foundation, etc.)

Title: Operations Manager (Food Operations)
Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
The Operations Manager (Food Operations) owns end-to-end food delivery service quality across the platform, specifically driving ETA promise accuracy, minimizing lateness, and reducing order cancellations. Since most operational levers sit within partner teams (Logistics, Product, Commerce, and Supply), this role operates through rigorous data-driven diagnosis, cross-functional prioritization, and strategic influence rather than direct operational control. Leading a direct team of 6 compliance specialists, the Operations Manager translates high-level service quality targets into actionable initiative portfolios, robust supply-hour requirements, and sustainable marketplace growth.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
**Service Quality & KPI Ownership**

* Own the daily monitoring, weekly review, and detailed root-cause analysis of food delivery metrics across key drivers (prep time, handover timer, distance, zone dynamics, and supply levels).
* Maintain end-to-end accountability for stream targets, including order volume growth (OPU), Mashallah (perfect) order rate, on-time delivery, cancellation rate, and short-distance speed SLAs.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all cross-functional lateness, cancellation, and delivery quality issues.

**Initiative Portfolio & Pilot Management**

* Manage and execute the strategic initiative portfolio: adjust ETA promises, eliminate merchant/zone inefficiencies, speed up merchant dispatch, and tune courier product features.
* Size initiative impacts, assign functional owners, define explicit deadlines, and evaluate pilot results before granting go/no-go approval for full production rollout.
* Collaborate with the Vertical Profitability Manager to establish and enforce strict quality guardrails (TDT, contact rate, lateness, cancellations) for profitability initiatives such as order bundling.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Alignment**

* Logistics & Product Alignment: Work with Logistics Algorithms and Product teams to adjust ETA/DPT accuracy, conduct elasticity tests, manage promotion-day promise adjustments, and enhance courier tools.
* Commerce & Merchant Quality: Partner with Commerce to reduce vendor prep and handover delays, adjust dispatch fitting for complex locations, and enforce merchant quality standards.
* Supply & Fleet Management: Translate service quality targets into precise supply-hour requirements for the Supply Team to drive full-timer (FT) courier acquisition and fleet capacity.

**Team Leadership & Direct Management**

* Directly manage, coach, and guide a direct team of 6 Compliance specialists based in Pakistan.
* Set clear individual performance targets, oversee daily audit workflows, and ensure team alignment with overarching platform quality goals.

**First 90 Days Roadmap & Execution**

* Day 30 (Diagnostics): Complete diagnostic mapping of lateness and cancellation drivers; build comprehensive KPI baselines and size/prioritize the initiative portfolio.
* Day 60 (Pilots): Launch 2–3 live pilots across Logistics, Product, and Commerce; establish weekly cross-functional governance cadences and finalize quality guardrails.
* Day 90 (Production Rollout): Evaluate pilots via go/no-go decisions, transition successful initiatives into production with defined owners and deadlines, and lock in long-term stream targets.

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**

* Extensive multi-cultural experience, adept at working with diverse teams and customers.

* Demonstrable experience in delivering innovative commercial opportunities with experience in increasing profitability especially within Resorts.

* Exceptional people leadership and retention of talent with the ability to bring a team together on a journey and instilling the Hilton culture and values.
* Exceptional stakeholder/owner relations experience with demonstrable influencing skills.
* Ability to show resilience, judgement and leadership.
* Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar resort style property.
* Proven experience in delivering results with an eye for details and quality
* Experience in GCC/Qatar will be an advantage
* Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent.
* Fluency in English and Arabic required (spoken and written)

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
