Title: The Berkeley Hotel Executive Housekeeper
Description:
**About Company:**

Looking for an inspired leader to head up our housekeeping department at the historic luxury Berkeley Hotel.

55 rooms. Previous hotel management housekeeping required. Must be able to work weekends. As this is a smaller hotel, the exec would be expected to have a board of their own near daily.

**Our Vision**

Our vision is to become the premier hotel development company with a concentration in Washington, committed to excellence through strategic development and continued innovation in the hospitality industry. Guided by our core values, we will exceed the expectations of our guests and members and enhance the value of our partners' investments.

**Our Mission**

Our mission is to provide the ultimate guest experience through exceptionally talented associates committed to providing true hospitality. We do this by providing support, training, and growth for our team members while being fiscally responsible to our owners and investors.

**About the Role:**

The Hotel Executive Housekeeper at Berkeley plays a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction throughout the property. This leadership position is responsible for managing and supervising the housekeeping team to maintain impeccable guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces. The Executive Housekeeper will develop and implement cleaning procedures, schedules, and quality control measures to optimize operational efficiency and uphold brand standards. Additionally, this role involves coordinating with other hotel departments to support seamless guest experiences and address any housekeeping-related concerns promptly. Ultimately, the Executive Housekeeper contributes significantly to the hotel's reputation by fostering a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for all guests and staff.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 years of experience in housekeeping, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or management role.
* Strong knowledge of cleaning.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a branded hotel environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and inventory management.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental sustainability practices.
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish, to communicate with a diverse workforce.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead, train, and supervise the housekeeping team to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality cleaning services.
* Develop and maintain cleaning schedules, inventory controls, and quality assurance protocols to meet brand and safety standards.
* Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces regularly to ensure cleanliness and maintenance needs are addressed.
* Collaborate with the front desk, maintenance, and management teams to coordinate room availability and resolve guest requests or complaints.
* Manage housekeeping budgets, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment procurement, while optimizing resource utilization.
* Recruit, onboard, and evaluate housekeeping staff performance, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.

**Skills:**

The Executive Housekeeper utilizes leadership and interpersonal skills daily to manage and inspire the housekeeping team, ensuring high morale and productivity. Organizational skills are critical for creating efficient cleaning schedules, managing inventory, and maintaining compliance with safety standards. Communication skills enable effective collaboration with other hotel departments and clear resolution of guest concerns. Problem-solving skills are essential when addressing unexpected maintenance issues or staffing challenges to maintain seamless operations. Additionally, knowledge of hospitality software and budgeting tools supports accurate tracking of expenses and resource allocation, contributing to the hotel's operational success.

Title: Hotel Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**

The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.

**About Raffles Doha**

Step into a world of refined elegance and timeless artistry at Raffles Doha, an iconic address nestled within the architectural landmark of Katara Towers in Lusail.

Raffles Doha is where luxury becomes deeply personal — a place defined by quiet sophistication, meaningful moments, and the art of thoughtful service. Rooted in a legacy of gracious hospitality, Raffles is renowned for creating experiences that are intimate, bespoke, and unforgettable.

Here, every detail is considered, every interaction intentional, and every guest journey uniquely curated. Our colleagues are artisans of hospitality, empowered to anticipate needs, craft memories, and deliver service with elegance, discretion, and genuine care.

Joining Raffles Doha means becoming part of a storied brand where excellence is not an aspiration, but a standard — and where hospitality is expressed as an art form.

**About the Application Process**

At Raffles Doha, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

 **Job Description**

We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles Doha as our new Hotel Manager.

The Hotel Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments, ensuring the delivery of exceptional luxury hospitality experiences in line with the standards and philosophy of Raffles Hotels & Resorts.

The role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, guest satisfaction, and colleague engagement while ensuring seamless coordination and alignment across all operational functions. Working closely with the Executive Committee and department heads, the Hotel Manager translates the hotel's strategic objectives into actionable business plans, strengthens operational efficiencies, and drives a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As a key member of the hotel's leadership team, the Hotel Manager acts as the Managing Director's principal operational partner, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, safeguarding the hotel's reputation, and reinforcing Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury hospitality destination.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Managing Director to define and execute the hotel's strategic objectives and priorities
* Provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across all hotel departments
* Drive operational excellence, revenue growth, profitability, and continuous improvement
* Monitor hotel performance and implement initiatives to enhance business results
* Ensure seamless operations and consistent delivery of Raffles brand standards
* Champion personalised luxury hospitality and exceptional guest experiences in line with Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards
* Oversee guest satisfaction, feedback, and effective service recovery
* Lead and develop the Executive Committee and departmental leaders, fostering a high-performance culture
* Drive colleague engagement, talent development, and succession planning
* Oversee financial performance, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and resource optimisation
* Maximise commercial opportunities and profitability across operational departments
* Ensure compliance with brand standards, company policies, and local regulations
* Oversee quality assurance, health and safety, security, and risk management
* Drive Forbes Travel Guide and LQA standards, audits, service evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Build strong relationships with ownership, corporate stakeholders, key clients, and external partners
* Collaborate with commercial and support functions to strengthen business performance and market positioning
* Promote innovation, technology, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience
* Safeguard the hotel's reputation and strengthen Raffles Doha's position as a leading luxury destination

  
**Qualifications**

**What will you bring to this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 10 years of experience in luxury hotel operations, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership position
* Proven track record within internationally recognised luxury hotel brands
* Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality standards, including Forbes Travel Guide, and LQA requirements
* Strong Food & Beverage experience across multiple outlets, with proven expertise in managing high-volume banquet operations
* Demonstrated success in driving operational excellence, financial performance, and guest satisfaction
* Strong commercial acumen and experience in budgeting, forecasting, and cost management
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop multicultural teams and senior leaders
* Excellent strategic thinking, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills
* Extensive knowledge of hotel operations, quality assurance, and service excellence
* Strong understanding of health, safety, security, and regulatory compliance
* Previous experience in the Middle East luxury hospitality market is preferred
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

  
**Additional Information**

**Employee Benefits**  
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

**Our Values**

Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity.

Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special.

Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together.

Empowerment: We have authority to take initiative and anticipate moments that create unforgettable experiences.

Integrity: We build trust through mutual respect and being authentic.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).

The Director of Marketing/Admissions is ultimately responsible for the facility’s census. While this individual cannot market nor fill the building themselves, they must be able to provide leadership to the marketing team that will lead to building and maintaining a high census.

This facility expects their employees to promote an atmosphere of teamwork with other employees and hospitality and comfort for its residents. Therefore, the following list of duties is not all-inclusive:

Promote the facility and its services to referring agencies. Maintain the current database of existing and potential referral sources.

* Protect the personal property of the residents of the facility.
* Others as directed by the supervisor or administrator.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Eight years equivalent experience in a sales/marketing position or Director of Admissions position in lieu of degree.
* Organized and detailed in work performance.
* Good communication skills with excellent self-discipline and patience.

Title: Senior Flower Procurement & Operations Manager (B2B & E-Commerce)
Location: Dubai Marina, DU, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**Company:** Melora Greens  
**Location:** Dubai, United Arab Emirates  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Seniority:** Senior Management  
**Industry:** Fresh Flowers, Floral Wholesale, Import & Distribution, E-Commerce

Melora Greens is a UAE-based floral business focused on supplying premium fresh flowers and floral products to both business and retail customers.

As we expand our operations, we are seeking an experienced, commercially driven **Senior Flower Procurement & Operations Manager** to lead our end-to-end flower sourcing, purchasing, import logistics, processing, inventory management, and B2B wholesale operations, while contributing to the continued growth of our B2C e-commerce platform.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership position for someone who understands the fresh flower supply chain from international farms and suppliers through to final delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Flower Procurement & International Sourcing

* Manage the complete flower procurement cycle, from sourcing and supplier negotiations to purchasing, shipment coordination, and delivery.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with international flower farms, growers, exporters, wholesalers, and suppliers.
* Source premium-quality fresh flowers from key international markets, including Kenya, Ecuador, Colombia, the Netherlands, and other relevant origins.
* Negotiate competitive purchasing prices, payment terms, shipment schedules, and supplier agreements.
* Evaluate seasonal availability, flower varieties, market pricing, quality grades, and purchasing opportunities.
* Develop purchasing forecasts based on B2B demand, seasonal trends, and anticipated B2C sales.
* Establish alternative sourcing channels to maintain consistent availability and minimize procurement risks.

2. Import Logistics & Supply Chain Management

* Oversee international flower shipments, freight coordination, customs clearance, and delivery scheduling.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, clearing agents, suppliers, and logistics partners.
* Ensure proper cold-chain management to maintain freshness and maximize product shelf life.
* Monitor shipment timelines, freight costs, import documentation, and compliance with applicable UAE regulations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce transportation costs, improve shipment efficiency, and minimize delays.
* Resolve shipment discrepancies, quality concerns, supplier claims, and logistical issues.

3. Flower Processing, Quality Control & Inventory

* Oversee the receiving, inspection, grading, hydration, conditioning, storage, and processing of fresh flowers.
* Implement standard operating procedures for flower handling, preservation, and quality assurance.
* Manage cold storage conditions, stock rotation, inventory accuracy, and product traceability.
* Minimize flower wastage, spoilage, and shrinkage through efficient purchasing and stock management.
* Establish quality standards for both wholesale and retail flower products.
* Lead and train operational teams in proper handling, processing, packing, and order fulfillment.

4. B2B Wholesale Operations & Commercial Growth

* Manage and optimize day-to-day B2B flower supply and wholesale distribution operations.
* Support the development of long-term relationships with florists, event companies, hospitality groups, corporate clients, and other wholesale customers.
* Develop competitive wholesale pricing structures while protecting profitability.
* Coordinate customer forecasts, bulk orders, recurring supply arrangements, and fulfillment schedules.
* Identify potential B2B market opportunities, customer segments, and product categories.
* Collaborate with sales and management teams to increase wholesale revenue, customer retention, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor procurement costs, landed costs, selling prices, and gross margins.

5. B2C E-Commerce Growth & Fulfillment

* Work closely with the e-commerce and marketing teams to support the expansion of **meloragreens.com**.
* Improve product availability, assortment planning, and inventory allocation for online retail orders.
* Help develop commercially attractive floral collections, seasonal offerings, and promotional products.
* Establish efficient order processing, packaging, quality control, and last-mile delivery procedures.
* Ensure reliable coordination between wholesale inventory and online retail demand.
* Identify opportunities to improve fulfillment speed, reduce wastage, increase margins, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Support the operational requirements for scaling daily online order volumes.

6. Business Planning & Performance Management

* Develop procurement budgets, operational forecasts, and supply chain improvement plans.
* Track key performance indicators, including landed costs, gross margins, inventory turnover, wastage, supplier performance, and fulfillment efficiency.
* Implement scalable systems and processes to support business expansion.
* Provide regular operational and commercial performance reports to management.
* Lead process improvements that strengthen profitability, quality, and service reliability across B2B and B2C channels.

**Essential Requirements**

* Minimum **7 years of relevant experience** in the fresh flower industry, including substantial experience in procurement, international sourcing, wholesale operations, or supply chain management.
* At least 3 years in a senior operational, procurement, or management position.
* Strong practical knowledge of fresh flower varieties, grading, quality assessment, conditioning, cold-chain logistics, and shelf-life management.
* Proven experience dealing directly with international flower farms, growers, exporters, and wholesale suppliers.
* Solid understanding of international flower purchasing, import processes, freight forwarding, and landed-cost calculations.
* Demonstrated experience managing B2B flower supply, bulk purchasing, and wholesale distribution.
* Strong commercial negotiation, supplier management, budgeting, and inventory planning skills.
* Ability to manage teams, establish operational procedures, and resolve supply chain challenges.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems.
* Excellent English communication and organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in the UAE or GCC fresh flower wholesale industry.
* Existing professional relationships with international flower suppliers and farms.
* Familiarity with UAE flower import procedures, customs requirements, and local distribution.
* Experience supporting retail flower businesses, online floral stores, or e-commerce fulfillment operations.
* Knowledge of demand forecasting, inventory automation, and procurement management systems.
* Experience scaling operations in a growing floral distribution business.

We are looking for more than a traditional purchasing manager.

The ideal candidate understands the **entire commercial and operational journey of fresh flowers—from negotiating with international growers and managing imports to conditioning, warehousing, wholesale distribution, and final customer fulfillment.**

You should be commercially sharp, operationally disciplined, and comfortable taking ownership of an expanding business.

You must be equally capable of developing strategic supplier relationships and stepping into daily operations to resolve practical challenges.

Most importantly, you should have the experience and initiative to help Melora Greens build a more profitable, efficient, and scalable flower supply business.

Why Join Melora Greens?

* Take ownership of a key leadership function within a growing floral business.
* Play an important role in expanding our B2B wholesale operations and B2C e-commerce platform.
* Work directly with management on commercial decisions, supplier relationships, and business development.
* Help establish systems, teams, and processes that will shape the company's future growth.
* Opportunity for long-term professional growth as the business expands.

Pay: AED15,000.00 - AED20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Procurement Manager

Our expertise spans the complete project lifecycle, including design, manufacturing, construction, surfacing, installation, and long-term maintenance of natural, hybrid, and synthetic turf systems.

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives.

* Identify and evaluate new suppliers, manufacturers, and strategic partners globally.
* Continuously assess market conditions, industry developments, and pricing trends to maximize procurement efficiencies.

**Cost Management & Value Engineering**

* Deliver measurable cost savings across all procurement categories.

* Analyse total cost of ownership rather than simply focusing on purchase price.

* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks and disruptions.
* Ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment to project sites.

* Maintain accurate procurement records and reporting systems.
* Ensure suppliers comply with company standards relating to quality, health and safety, environmental compliance, and sustainability.
* Implement procurement best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the procurement function across the business.
* Mentor and support procurement and supply chain personnel.
* Establish procurement KPIs and performance metrics.
* Prepare and present procurement reports to senior management.
* Drive a culture of commercial excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years' procurement experience, with at least 5 years in a senior procurement role.
* Experience within construction, sports infrastructure, civil engineering, manufacturing, or related industries.
* Proven ability to negotiate significant cost savings without compromising quality.
* Strong commercial, analytical, and contract management skills.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Essential**

* Outstanding negotiation and influencing skills.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Ability to consistently source high-quality products at the most competitive prices.
* Excellent contract management and procurement knowledge.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strategic thinker with excellent decision-making ability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to perform under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

**Preferred**

* Experience procuring sports turf systems, construction materials, irrigation systems, sports lighting, equipment, or specialist infrastructure products.
* Experience working across international markets.
* Knowledge of procurement software and ERP systems.

Title: Managing Director - Real Estate
Location: Jebel Ali, DU, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**HAMDAN AL MANSOORI GROUP**  
*“Where ambition meets opportunity.”*

**WE ARE HIRING: MANAGING DIRECTOR – REAL ESTATE**  
**Dubai, UAE | Full-time | In person**

**Have you established and led a real estate company across leasing, property management, and brokerage?**

Hamdan Al Mansoori Group is seeking an accomplished executive to establish, lead, and grow a fully operational real estate business in Dubai.

We are looking for a business builder with proven experience turning a business vision into a functioning company: defining its services, building its team, establishing operating systems, securing clients and property portfolios, and delivering sustainable financial results.

Reporting to Group Management, you will hold overall responsibility for the company’s strategy, commercial development, operations, people, service delivery, and profitability.

**YOUR MANDATE**

Build an integrated real estate business with three core revenue streams:

* **Leasing:** Residential and commercial leasing, landlord representation, tenant acquisition, and renewals.
* **Property Management:** Securing and managing property management mandates, developing recurring fee income, and delivering consistent service to landlords and tenants.
* **Brokerage:** Secondary-market and off-plan sales, supported by productive agents, strong developer relationships, and effective transaction management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Company Establishment & Business Leadership**

* Develop and execute the company’s business plan, organisational structure, operating model, budgets, and financial targets.
* Define service offerings, target markets, pricing, revenue streams, and growth priorities.
* Lead business establishment and operational readiness, coordinating licensing and regulatory requirements with the relevant specialists.
* Establish policies, procedures, delegated authorities, reporting systems, and internal controls.
* Build the required business functions, coordinating with Group Finance, HR, IT, and other shared services.

**Leasing & Property Management**

* Secure landlord relationships, leasing instructions, and property management contracts.
* Develop a commercially viable portfolio with clear targets for managed units, occupancy, renewals, management fees, and collections.
* Establish processes for property onboarding, leasing administration, tenant relations, renewals, inspections, and landlord reporting.
* Oversee maintenance coordination, service providers, operating costs, and service quality.
* Work with Finance to establish accurate property accounting, collection controls, and clear reporting of client funds.
* Strengthen landlord retention and expand the portfolio through service performance, referrals, and direct business development.

**Business Development & Brokerage**

* Personally originate business through established relationships, direct outreach, referrals, and strategic partnerships.
* Build relationships with property owners, investors, developers, and corporate clients.
* Develop the brokerage’s sales capability, listings portfolio, and transaction pipeline.
* Oversee negotiations, transaction execution, commission collection, and client relationship management.
* Define marketing and property portal requirements through clear business cases, approved budgets, and measurable commercial returns.

**Team Building & Operational Management**

* Recruit and develop the required leasing, property management, brokerage, and administrative teams within approved budgets.
* Establish job responsibilities, targets, KPIs, training programmes, and performance review processes.
* Train managers and employees in client acquisition, property services, negotiation, operational procedures, and service standards.
* Implement effective CRM, portfolio management, listing, documentation, and reporting systems.
* Lead daily operations, resolve escalated issues, and maintain accountability across departments.

**Financial Performance & Governance**

* Take full responsibility for the company’s profit and loss, cash flow planning, revenue forecasts, and cost control.
* Monitor recurring income, transaction revenue, collections, staffing costs, and operating margins.
* Establish management dashboards covering commercial performance, portfolio growth, service delivery, and financial results.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, contractual obligations, and Group policies.
* Present performance updates, corrective actions, investment requirements, and growth proposals to Group Management.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* At least **10 years of real estate experience**, including **5 years in senior executive leadership within the UAE**.
* Proven experience as a Managing Director, CEO, General Manager, or equivalent, with responsibility for an entire real estate business and its financial performance.
* Demonstrated experience establishing or substantially building a real estate company, including its team, systems, service lines, and client base.
* **Direct operational experience in leasing and property management is essential**, alongside brokerage experience.
* A measurable record of securing property management mandates, growing portfolios, building productive teams, and improving profitability.
* Strong relationships with landlords, property owners, investors, developers, and business partners in Dubai.
* Experience developing business plans, managing budgets, implementing operating controls, and leading multiple functions.
* Ability to generate business through relationships, partnerships, referrals, and direct commercial activity.
* Strong recruitment, training, negotiation, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* RERA certification is required.
* A relevant bachelor’s degree is preferred.

**INTERVIEW PRESENTATION**

Shortlisted candidates will present a practical business establishment and growth plan covering:

* Proposed business model and priorities across leasing, property management, and brokerage.
* Initial client acquisition strategy and approach to securing management mandates.
* Organisational structure, hiring sequence, and employee training.
* Setup costs, operating budget, systems, and required management support.
* Revenue assumptions, cash flow projections, and measurable KPIs.
* A credible roadmap targeting **break-even within 90 days and profitability by month five**, with clearly stated assumptions and resource requirements.

Candidates should be ready to discuss businesses they have built or led, their personal contribution, and the results achieved.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive executive remuneration.
* Performance-based incentives linked to agreed business results.
* The opportunity to establish and lead a real estate business within Hamdan Al Mansoori Group.
* Long-term leadership and growth opportunities as the business expands.
* Company benefits in accordance with applicable UAE Labour Law and company policy.

Title: Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Manager
Description:
**Location:** Canada or United States (Remote / Hybrid; East Coast preferred, Greater Toronto Area a plus)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**About Adonis Partners**

At Adonis Partners, we exist to help our clients become more profitable — and their people more capable. We show up to do the real work, shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients, committed to creating lasting, measurable impact.

We are a fast-growing business excellence consultancy of 60 professionals across North America, serving over 30 clients annually.

We combine data-driven insights, deep industry experience, and lived leadership to cut through complexity and deliver results. Our team is built on a foundation of openness, humility, and relentless value creation. That’s how we’ve earned trust — and why clients call us back.

We partner most often with companies in:

* Food & Beverage Manufacturing
* Healthcare and Life Sciences
* Packaging
* Transportation, Logistics, and Supply Chain

Our clients are typically upper mid-market ($200M to $2B in revenue), including PE-backed companies undergoing operational transformation. Engagements range from 3–12 months, often involving immersive, on-site collaboration.

**Our Values (How We Work)**

* Genuine, Transparent & Fair – We tell the truth, even when it’s hard.
* Relentless in Creating Value – We own the outcome, no matter the obstacles.
* Always Getting Better – We seek feedback and grow through experience.
* Move Fast – We take action with urgency and accountability.
* Go the Extra Mile – We roll up our sleeves and do what it takes.

We live a service philosophy based on vulnerability, humility, and radical honesty. It’s not always comfortable, but it builds the kind of trust that lasts.

**Position Summary**

As the Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Specialist, you will own and deliver full-cycle recruitment for Adonis Partners across Canada and the United States. You will work closely with company leadership and practice leaders to understand current and upcoming client engagement needs, translate those needs into clear talent profiles, and identify high-calibre consultants and professionals who can deliver measurable results for our clients.

This role requires more than general recruiting experience. You will develop targeted talent pipelines across consulting, supply chain, procurement, operational excellence, Lean Six Sigma, and business transformation. You will recruit for both permanent and project-based needs, build relationships with experienced independent consultants, and help ensure Adonis Partners can respond quickly to client requirements while maintaining a high standard of candidate experience.

**Key Responsibilities Recruitment Strategy & Workforce Planning**

* Partner with leadership and practice leads to understand business priorities, client demand, upcoming projects, and resource requirements.
* Clarify role requirements, including technical capabilities, industry experience, consulting experience, seniority, location, availability, travel expectations, and engagement duration.
* Develop practical sourcing and recruitment plans for permanent hires, contract professionals, and project-based consulting resources.
* Prioritize recruitment activities based on client timelines, business needs, and the availability of qualified talent.
* Provide market feedback on talent availability, candidate expectations, compensation ranges, and recruitment challenges across Canada and the United States.

**Consulting & Industry-Specific Talent Sourcing**

Identify and attract professionals across Adonis Partners’ core service areas, including:

* **Supply Chain & Procurement:** Supply Chain Transformation Consultants, Procurement Consultants, Strategic Sourcing Specialists, Category Management Professionals, S&OP and Planning Specialists, Inventory Optimization Experts, Logistics and Distribution Professionals, and Supplier Performance Specialists.
* **Operational & Business Excellence**: Lean Six Sigma practitioners (Green Belt, Black Belt, and Master Black Belt), Operational Excellence Consultants, Business Excellence Consultants, Continuous Improvement Leaders, Process Improvement Specialists, and Change Management Professionals.
* **Business & Transformation**: Management Consultants, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Program Managers, Business Systems Analysts, Data Analysts, and Business Intelligence Professionals.
* Assess candidates for the combination of functional expertise, industry knowledge, problem-solving ability, communication, facilitation, and client-facing skills required in consulting environments.
* Recognize the difference between candidates with operational experience and practitioners who have successfully led or delivered transformation and improvement initiatives.

**Full-Cycle Recruitment & Candidate Assessment**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, sourcing, resume screening, introductory calls, structured interviews, candidate shortlisting, interview coordination, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff.
* Conduct initial candidate interviews to assess experience, consulting capabilities, project examples, communication skills, motivation, compensation expectations, location, and availability.
* Evaluate candidates against role-specific criteria and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations to hiring stakeholders.
* Coordinate technical, functional, and leadership interviews with practice leaders and other interviewers.
* Maintain timely and professional communication with candidates throughout the process, including feedback and status updates.
* Support offer discussions and closing activities while ensuring candidate expectations are aligned with the role and engagement requirements.

**Canada & United States Talent Acquisition**

* Build and maintain active talent pipelines across Canadian and US markets for current and anticipated hiring needs.
* Use LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, referrals, job boards, industry groups, and other sourcing channels to identify qualified candidates.
* Develop an understanding of regional talent markets, role availability, compensation expectations, and relevant employment practices.
* Confirm candidate location, work authorization status, willingness to travel, and availability for the relevant role or client assignment.
* Coordinate with leadership and appropriate internal or external resources when cross-border work authorization or employment considerations require review; do not provide legal or immigration advice.
* Adapt sourcing strategies to support remote, hybrid, and client-site assignments across North America.

**Talent Pipeline & Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain a searchable network of qualified consultants and professionals, including independent consultants and contract talent.
* Maintain accurate candidate profiles covering skills, industry experience, project history, certifications, location, availability, compensation expectations, and engagement preferences.
* Build long-term relationships with high-potential candidates, including individuals who may not be suitable for an immediate opening but could fit future engagements.
* Create talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill capabilities, particularly in procurement, supply chain, operational excellence, and Lean Six Sigma.
* Re-engage previously screened or placed candidates as new client requirements arise.

**Recruitment Operations, Systems & Reporting**

* Maintain complete and accurate candidate and recruitment records in Salesforce or the company’s designated recruitment tracking system.
* Track each recruitment requirement from intake through placement, including sourcing activity, candidate status, interview feedback, decisions, and outcomes.
* Prepare regular recruitment pipeline updates for leadership, highlighting progress, bottlenecks, risks, and support required.
* Monitor recruitment metrics such as time to shortlist, time to fill, qualified candidates presented, interview conversion, offer acceptance, and successful placements.
* Develop and improve standardized job descriptions, interview guides, candidate scorecards, recruitment workflows, and reporting templates.
* Maintain confidentiality and handle candidate information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

**Qualifications Required**

* 7+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably within management consulting, professional services, staffing, or specialized professional recruitment.
* Experience sourcing and recruiting professional talent in both Canada and the United States.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit specialized roles in areas such as supply chain, procurement, operations, engineering, business transformation, or consulting.
* Experience recruiting for permanent, contract, and/or project-based positions.
* Strong candidate sourcing skills using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, professional networks, and other recruitment channels.
* Ability to understand role requirements, assess relevant experience, and distinguish strong client-facing consultants from candidates with only general functional experience.
* Strong interviewing, communication, relationship-building, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple open requirements and changing priorities while meeting hiring timelines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and recruitment tracking systems; experience with Salesforce or another CRM/ATS is an asset.

**Preferred**

* Experience recruiting Lean Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, Business Excellence, Continuous Improvement, Procurement, or Supply Chain Transformation professionals.
* Familiarity with consulting project structures, client engagements, statements of work, and resource-based staffing models.
* Existing professional networks in Canadian and US supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, or consulting communities.
* Experience supporting recruitment for senior consultants, practice leaders, and executive-level roles.
* Experience building talent communities or maintaining a proactive pipeline for recurring or specialized roles.
* Knowledge of compensation trends and talent market conditions in Canada and the United States.

**Desired Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and resourceful, with the persistence to identify high-quality candidates beyond active applicants.
* Relationship-oriented and able to build trust with candidates, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
* Commercially aware and able to connect recruitment priorities to client needs, project delivery, and business growth.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial consulting environment where priorities can shift quickly.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and accountable for follow-through.
* A strong communicator who represents Adonis Partners professionally and authentically.
* Curious and willing to learn the language of supply chain, procurement, operational excellence, and management consulting.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* *Recruitment delivery:* timely shortlists and successful placements against agreed hiring requirements.
* *Candidate quality:* relevance and suitability of candidates presented to hiring leaders and clients.
* *Pipeline strength:* depth, accuracy, and readiness of qualified talent pools across Canada and the United States.
* *Recruitment effectiveness:* sourcing-to-interview conversion, interview-to-offer conversion, and offer acceptance.
* *Stakeholder experience:* feedback from leadership, practice leads, hiring managers, and candidates.
* *Process discipline:* accurate candidate records, timely status updates, and reliable recruitment reporting.
* *Continuous improvement:* practical improvements to sourcing methods, assessment processes, and recruitment workflows.

**Our Commitment to You**

* Join a collaborative, entrepreneurial consulting firm where your work directly supports business growth and client success.
* Work closely with company leadership and practice leaders across a growing North American consulting business.
* Build relationships with experienced professionals across a range of industries and specialized consulting disciplines.
* Help shape and strengthen the talent acquisition function as the firm continues to grow.
* Competitive salary and performance-based bonus opportunities.
* An honest and transparent culture free from corporate politics.
* A culture that cares deeply for the well-being of our people, clients, partners, and community.

**Ideal Candidates Will…**

* Understand that recruiting consultants requires assessing both functional expertise and the ability to deliver results in client environments.
* Enjoy building relationships and talent networks before a specific vacancy arises.
* Be comfortable engaging with senior professionals and discussing complex consulting experience.
* Take ownership of recruitment outcomes and communicate openly when requirements, timelines, or candidate availability change.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-trust environment and continuously look for better ways to attract and assess talent.

If that sounds like you — let’s talk.

**Application Requirements**

Interested candidates should submit:

* Resume
* Cover letter outlining relevant recruitment experience and exposure to Canadian and US talent markets
* Brief examples of specialized or consulting roles successfully recruited, including the sourcing approach and outcomes where possible

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country in which they are based. Adonis Partners welcomes applications from qualified candidates with experience supporting recruitment across Canada and the United States. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Greater Toronto Area, ON: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (preferred)

Title: ERP Transformation Manager - Retail Front of House
Description:
General Information
  
  
**Ref #**
237137
  
  
**Location:**
Qatar-Doha
  
  
**Job family:**
Corporate & Commercial
  
  
**Closing Date:**
2026-11-21
  
  
**Description**
**About the Role**
Project WAHED is the Qatar Airways Group's ERP transformation across the whole Group. It covers Retail, Hospitality, Finance, Supply Chain and HR across the Group's businesses.
  
  
We are seeking an ERP Transformation Manager – Retail to own the Retail Front of House discipline for Project WAHED. You will be the single accountable business owner for the store-facing retail platform: Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Sale, Xstore Office and XOCS, plus the related store technology estate. You will also own all Front of House data, testing and validation through to go-live and post-go-live support. You will help connect store and digital channels, including order orchestration with eCommerce, so customers get one consistent experience across every channel.
  
  
This is a delivery role.
  
  
**Specific Responsibilities For The Role Include**

* Own the Retail Front of House solution end to end, from build to steady state. This covers Xstore Point of Sale, Xstore Office/XOCS, till hardware, peripherals, payment integration and related store technology.
* Lead Front of House data migration across all conversion cycles: object ownership, cleansing, load validation, reconciliation and formal sign-off of converted data.
* Own the Front of House test agenda across integration, user acceptance, security and operational testing. This includes scenario coverage, scripts, test data, oversight of test runs, defect triage and exit sign-off.
* Write, review and challenge test scripts and validation approaches so that testing proves the stores can operate, not just that the system works.
* Represent Front of House in design authority and change control forums, and explain the store operating model clearly to business, IT and delivery partner stakeholders.
* Drive cutover and go-live readiness for stores. This includes till readiness, the rollback position, protecting day-one trading and the hypercare support model.
* Plan and manage a high-volume point of sale rollout across a large, multi-site store estate, timing deployment around trading peaks and store operating constraints.
* Support the omnichannel order flows between stores and eCommerce, such as click and collect, ship-from-store, store fulfilment and returns, working with Oracle Retail Order Orchestration Cloud Service / Order Broker Cloud Service (OROB).
* Partner with Store Operations, Finance, IT, Loyalty, eCommerce and the systems integrator to close solution dependencies.
* Lead change, training readiness and super-user enablement for the store population alongside the Change workstream.
* Manage risks, issues and dependencies for the discipline, escalating with clear options and recommendations.
* Perform other department duties related to the position as directed by the Head of the Department.

Qualification
  
  
**Essential**
**About You — Qualifications, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent with a minimum of 6 years of job-related experience
* Direct experience with Oracle Retail Xstore Point of Sale / Xstore Office / XOCS, or an equivalent enterprise point of sale platform
* 6+ years in retail store operations or retail technology, with direct ownership of point of sale and store back-office systems
* 5+ years in business transformation and ERP implementation
* Delivery through the full implementation lifecycle (data migration, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare) in a live trading environment
* Hands-on test management experience: scenario design, script writing and review, test data, defect management and formal exit sign-off
* Experience managing multi-site rollouts at scale, including deployment sequencing, site readiness and post-deployment support
* Experience leading cross-functional process improvement projects
* Experience with process mapping and process flow analysis tools

**Preferred (Good To Have)**

* Experience with Oracle Retail Order Orchestration Cloud Service / Order Broker Cloud Service (OROB), or an equivalent distributed order management platform
* Omnichannel retail experience, such as click and collect, ship-from-store, endless aisle, cross-channel returns, and store-to-eCommerce inventory visibility and fulfilment
* Professional certifications in Oracle ERP or Oracle Retail
* 5+ years directly leading ERP implementations and rollouts
* Experience of travel retail, duty-free or airport retail operations
* Experience with project management or Agile delivery in a regulated environment
* Data and access governance experience, and experience implementing dashboards and KPI reporting

**Job Specific Skills**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor clear, concise messages for every audience, from the store floor to executives
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent project management skills
* Ability to work effectively across business, IT and systems integrator partners
* Comfortable working under pressure against fixed delivery milestones

* The Digital Project, Governance & MIS Manager plays a mission-critical role in driving the organization’s automation strategy, reinforcing its risk management framework, and enabling data-driven decision-making through robust management information systems (MIS).
* This position requires a rare combination of specialized expertise in AI governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise-scale digital project management.
* The role is responsible for leading strategic projects from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory standards, and internal policies.
* It also involves overseeing governance frameworks and ensuring the delivery of accurate, timely, and actionable management information to support operational transparency and strategic planning.

* Deliver accurate, timely MI and enhance reporting systems to support strategic decisions and performance tracking.
* Proactively manage risks, minimize disruptions, and strengthen business continuity planning.
* Ensure effective coordination and alignment with internal and external stakeholders to meet business objectives.
* Maintain high-quality standards, ensure compliance, and continuously improve governance practices through KPI tracking.
* Drive standardization, accuracy and automation of MI dashboards and management reporting, highlighting key trends, exceptions, risks and performance improvement opportunities.

5 Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships
  
  

* The Digital Projects, Governance & MI Manager operates within a fast-paced, digitally evolving, and tightly regulated retail banking environment.
* The role demands strategic oversight of digital transformation initiatives, governance frameworks, and MIS reporting, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory standards.
* The manager must remain agile and informed, continuously adapting to emerging technologies, regulatory updates, and industry best practices—particularly in the realm of AI-driven automation and analytics.
* The manager’s scope spans across designated units, subsidiaries, and operational functions within Retail Banking Operations, with clearly defined responsibilities to ensure optimal resource utilization and accountability.
* Key focus areas include governance activities such as Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), Operational Risk Management (ORM), Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and reconciliation oversight.
* The role establishes and enforces decision-making structures, authority levels, and compliance protocols to maintain high standards of operational integrity and regulatory adherence.
* AI integration is a critical component, with the manager responsible for identifying and implementing AI solutions to enhance process efficiency, predictive analytics, and data-driven decision-making across governance and MIS functions.
* Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams including project management, risk, compliance, operations, and IT to ensure seamless execution of digital initiatives and governance processes.
* Acts as a key liaison with external stakeholders such as regulatory authorities, technology vendors, and service providers, fostering transparent communication and strategic partnerships.
* Provides regular updates and insights to senior leadership on project milestones, risk exposures, compliance status, and AI adoption progress, ensuring alignment with the bank’s strategic objectives and digital roadmap.

6 Problem Solving
  
  

* The Digital Projects, Governance & MI Manager plays a pivotal role in proactively identifying and resolving challenges across project execution, governance, and operational continuity within Retail Banking Operations.
* The role demands a strategic mindset, analytical rigor, and the ability to leverage emerging technologies—particularly AI—to drive smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions.
* Proactively identifies potential risks—ranging from regulatory shifts to operational disruptions—and formulates mitigation strategies.
* This includes leading initiatives such as Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Operational Risk Management (ORM), with AI-powered risk modeling and predictive analytics enhancing early detection and response capabilities.
* Ensures all digital projects and operational processes remain compliant with evolving regulatory frameworks. The manager continuously monitors industry regulations and integrates AI-driven compliance tools to automate monitoring, reporting, and policy updates.
* Strategically allocates and manages human, financial, and technological resources to meet project demands and overcome constraints.
* AI-based resource planning tools are utilized to forecast needs, optimize utilization, and improve cost-efficiency.
* Maintains strong communication and alignment with internal teams and external partners. The manager uses collaborative platforms and AI-enabled sentiment analysis to identify potential friction points and facilitate timely conflict resolution.
* Tracks project performance using defined KPIs and dashboards. AI-driven analytics support real-time performance insights, enabling swift adjustments to keep projects on track and aligned with strategic goals.
* Designs and implements Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Business Impact Analysis (BIA) frameworks to ensure uninterrupted operations during crises. AI simulations and scenario modeling are employed to stress-test plans and enhance preparedness.

7 Decision Making Authority & Responsibility
  
  

* The Digital Projects, Governance & MIS Manager holds strategic decision-making authority across the lifecycle of digital initiatives and governance functions within Retail Banking Operations.
* The role is empowered to drive transformation, ensure compliance, and optimize performance—leveraging AI technologies to enhance decision quality, speed, and impact.

* Holds the authority to identify, assess, and implement risk mitigation strategies, particularly in areas such as Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) and Operational Risk Management (ORM). AI-powered risk analytics are used to enhance foresight and automate risk detection.
* Responsible for ensuring all projects and operations adhere to internal policies and external regulatory standards. This includes decision-making related to Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and reconciliation processes. AI solutions are employed to automate compliance tracking and reporting.
* Authorized to manage relationships and communications with internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business objectives. AI-driven collaboration platforms and sentiment analysis tools support effective engagement and conflict resolution.
* Oversees project performance, budget adherence, and delivery outcomes. Decisions are informed by AI-enabled dashboards and KPIs, allowing for data-driven course corrections and resource optimization.
* Acts as the central point of contact between internal departments and external entities, ensuring consistent communication and strategic alignment. AI tools assist in synthesizing stakeholder feedback and aligning project goals with evolving business needs.

**8 Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* The Digital Projects, Governance & MIS Manager brings a robust blend of domain expertise, leadership capabilities, and technological acumen to drive strategic initiatives within Retail Banking Operations.

* Over 10 years of experience in project management, preferably within the banking or financial services sector.
* Hands-on experience in managing project budgets, financial planning, and resource allocation.
* Familiarity with AI-driven tools and platforms for project tracking, risk analytics, and MIS reporting.
* Ability to leverage AI for predictive insights, process automation, and enhanced decision-making in governance and operations.

Title: Retail Director
Description:
Who are we?

A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself.At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that diverse perspectives foster creativity and knowledge to deliver excellence.

Are you a good match?

You have extensive experience in luxury retail management, with a strong track record in driving business performance, developing teams and implementing successful retail strategies.

You are a strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen, excellent leadership skills and the ability to navigate complex business environments. You naturally build strong relationships with stakeholders and inspire teams to achieve excellence.

Analytical, proactive and results-oriented, you combine a client-centric mindset with a genuine passion for luxury retail. Your ability to drive change, foster collaboration and develop talent will be key to succeeding in this role.

  
  

What are we expecting from you?

As Market Retail Director, you will define and implement the retail strategy across the Market, in alignment with the Maison’s vision and business objectives.

Working closely with the Managing Director, Regional and International teams, you will drive business performance, ensure operational excellence and lead the development of retail teams while delivering an exceptional client experience.

  
  

Your main responsibilities will include:

* Defining and implementing the Market retail strategy to drive sales, profitability and sustainable business growth.

* Monitoring business performance through key retail KPIs, identifying opportunities and implementing action plans to enhance boutique performance.

* Leading, coaching and developing Boutique Managers and retail teams, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.

* Partnering with HR to anticipate talent needs, support recruitment, succession planning and team development across the retail network.

* Overseeing boutique operations and ensuring compliance with Maison standards, policies and operational procedures.

* Collaborating with Retail Operations, Marketing, Client Experience, Finance and other cross-functional teams to support business priorities and commercial initiatives.

* Driving the implementation of regional and international retail initiatives, ensuring alignment with local market needs and business objectives.

* Identifying business opportunities, monitoring market trends and competition, and providing strategic insights to Regional and International teams.

* Leading boutique development projects, including new openings, network optimization and the maintenance of high retail standards.

* Defining and implementing High Jewelry client development strategies, supporting VIP client relationships and identifying opportunities to strengthen the Maison’s client portfolio.

* Supporting the development of High Jewelry expertise within retail teams through coaching, training and talent identification.

* Acting as an ambassador of the Maison, nurturing relationships with key clients and partners while supporting exclusive client events and commercial opportunities.

  
  

More than a role… We recruit for a career!

By joining Van Cleef & Arpels, you will become part of a Maison where excellence, creativity and people development are at the heart of everything we do.

From your first day, you will be supported through comprehensive onboarding and continuous learning opportunities designed to help you grow your expertise and build a long-term career within the Maison and the Richemont Group.

  
  

The Recruitment Process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application, and should your profile match our requirements, you will be invited to meet with the recruiter. You will then have the opportunity to meet with the Hiring Manager and relevant business stakeholders throughout the recruitment journey.

Title: Safety Manager
Description:
dnata is more than a global air and travel services provider. We connect people with possibilities and opportunities across 130+ airports in 34 countries through ground handling, cargo, travel, and catering & retail services. Our purpose is clear: to deliver on the promises our customers make. We are powered by a bold vision to be the world’s most admired air and travel services provider, which guides our strategy, culture, and every role across our teams. Our core values fuel everything we do: we are safe, we play to win, we respect everyone and work together as a team, and we are future thinking. At dnata we foster diversity, nurture ambition, and celebrate achievement. If you're inspired by purpose and motivated to be part of a global team shaping the future of aviation and travel, we’d love to have you onboard.
  
On the ground, dnata USA keeps 27 of the country’s major airports connected – both with each other and the world - including John F. Kennedy Airport in New York City. Handling 200,000 tonnes of cargo, guiding 15,000,000 passengers and keeping 50,000 flights in the air each year, the work that the dnata USA team complete on the ground is crucial to keeping the country in the air.
  
  
Safety Manager
  
Influential position dedicated to the development, implementation and promotion of a safe, accident free, and healthy work environment. Coordinates with the Corporate Safety department and local management in the development and implementation of dnata’s One Safety program to promote a proactive safety culture. Manages a group of local Safety Coordinators and reports directly to the Regional Safety, Training, and Compliance Manager over the Northeast.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Supports the implementation of safety policies and procedures to be followed by Company personnel in compliance with local, state, and federal occupational safety and health, environmental, and security requirements
  
  
Consults with all departments on design and use of equipment, facilities, fire prevention, safety and environmental programs
  
  
Leads hazard/risk analysis efforts and assists in the identification of mitigation methods
  
  
Performs an assurance function as it relates to the entire training evolution – classroom, OJT and recurrent.
  
  
Conducts observations, inspections and audits. Prepares reports and communicates unsafe findings to appropriate authorities addressing root causes and determining corrective action
  
  
Ensures compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies and meeting compliance requirements from our customers
  
  
Supports and drives the investigation of near misses, incidents, and coordinates the preparation of material and evidence to identify root causes for the purpose of developing corrective and preventative actions
  
  
Maintain files and records as necessary
  
  
Provides direction, management, technical expertise and training to support our IMS and SMS programs
  
  
Ensures and participates in safety board meetings
  
  
Proactively performs graphical and numerical analysis of hazards, near misses and incidents to determine trends. Provides recommendations to senior management in an effort to achieve the safest environment possible.
  
  
Review/approve planning, design, and modification of materials processes, operations, personnel changes or building layouts affecting all aspects of the IMS/SMS.
  
  
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge,
  
  
skill, and/or ability required.
  
  
Job Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s Degree in a related field, or an equivalent level of education and experience.
  
  
Minimum seven (7) years of experience in the aviation industry

Title: Director of Campus Safety
Description:
Randolph-Macon College invites applications for a full-time Director of Campus Safety. Reporting to the Vice President of Student Affairs (VPSA), the Director provides strategic and operational leadership to the Department of Campus Safety, ensuring the department supports the College’s mission of learning, teaching, and research through a safe and welcoming educational environment. The Director oversees departmental policies, personnel recruitment and training, and the implementation of standards for campus patrol, investigations, emergency response, crime prevention, special events, parking, and safety programs. The position also promotes open communication and collaboration between the department and the College community.

**Responsibilities**

*(Including, but are not limited to, the following):*

* Direct, manage, and supervise the Department of Campus Safety, establishing measurable goals, appropriate staffing levels, quality assurance, training, performance management, regular reporting, and continuous improvement. Oversee performance appraisals for departmental leadership staff, including the Assistant Director and Operations Manager, and delegate authority and responsibilities appropriately.
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and execution of the College’s emergency preparedness programs, including evacuation and shelter procedures, drills, tabletop exercises, and after-action reviews. Serve as a member of the College’s Emergency Response Team, providing ICS-trained leadership and preparing Incident Action Plans for major campus events.
* Develop and implement crime prevention strategies, policies, procedures, and training objectives. Identify and mitigate campus-wide security vulnerabilities and potential liability risks, recommending improvements to lighting, access control, cameras, and residence hall security in collaboration with Physical Plant and Information Technology.
* Serve as the Campus Safety Survey Administrator for the Clery Act, overseeing campus crime reporting, timely warnings, emergency notifications, recordkeeping, training, coordination with relevant College offices, and preparation of the Annual Security Report.
* Oversee investigations, including internal affairs investigations and complaints from the College community. Assign incidents for investigation to officers, delegate specialized tasks, and ensure appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Build trust and maintain positive relationships with students, collaborating with Student Affairs to address substance-related incidents, respond appropriately to behavioral health crises, and promote trauma-informed, de-escalation-based practices. Serve as a member of the College’s Behavioral Assessment & Intervention Team and assist with programs related to The Edge Program.
* Establish and maintain relationships with local law enforcement agencies and other first responders, including local, county, state, and federal agencies, Emergency Operations Officials, CSX Police, and Amtrak Police.
* Prepare and manage the departmental budget and ensure resources are allocated effectively to support departmental operations and campus safety priorities.
* Serve as a member of the VPSA’s Senior Leadership Team (Coordinating Team). Communicate significant incidents, including those that may attract media attention, to the VPSA and other College administrators, and evaluate and recommend actions in the best interest of the College and the safety of the community.
* Oversee campus safety support for major College events, including Commencement, home football games, and other events requiring Campus Safety and Ashland Police Department presence. Maintain familiarity with the Rydin electronic ticketing system to understand how campus parking citations are issued and processed.
* Perform other duties as requested by the VPSA or Dean of Students.

**Knowledge, skills, and abilities**

* Ability to make critical decisions, evaluate sensitive or delicate situations, and recommend appropriate courses of action to achieve desirable or reasonable outcomes.
* Ability to motivate, effectively supervise, counsel, and evaluate employees; deploy personnel appropriately based on established priorities and situational needs; and apply effective human resources practices.
* Ability to plan, cooperate, and communicate effectively with others, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to establish short- and long-term goals that support the academic environment and priorities of the College.
* Knowledge of crime prevention strategies and the ability to take active measures to promote campus safety.
* Knowledge of federal and state laws and regulations relevant to higher education, including Title IX, VAWA, Title II, and other applicable federal mandates.
* Appropriate training and understanding of NIMS/ICS procedures, including current certifications in ICS 100, 200, 700, and 800, Incident Action Plan development, and crisis management. ICS 300 and 400 certifications preferred.
* Current certification in Basic Life Support (CPR/AED) and Basic First Aid.
* Technical competency in Microsoft Office products and relevant campus systems, including Alertus, DSX door access systems, camera-based review systems, ADP payroll, Maxient, and Pharos (HIVE).

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in criminology, criminal justice, or a related field, or equivalent experience and/or training in law enforcement, security, or safety work.
* At least five years of progressively responsible experience in campus safety, public safety, law enforcement, emergency management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience supervising personnel, managing budgets, and responding to critical incidents.
* Strong communication, judgment, conflict resolution, and relationship-building skills.
* Commonwealth of Virginia DCJS certification as a security/safety officer, or the ability to obtain certification within six months.
* Valid driver's license and ability to successfully complete a criminal background investigation and DMV review.

**Preferred:**

* Experience leading public safety operations in higher education, particularly at a residential college.
* Experience with Clery Act compliance, institutional emergency planning, and emergency response.
* Advanced training in incident command, behavioral threat assessment, and crisis response.
* Experience working with students and multidisciplinary support teams.

**WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The position involves potential physical risks when responding to armed or belligerent individuals, trespassers, and injured persons, including exposure to bodily fluids. The position requires the physical ability to perform essential job functions associated with campus safety operations, including responding to emergencies and potentially hazardous situations. The Director must be able to protect themselves and serve the campus community while continually assessing risks and potential liability associated with departmental operations. As an essential employee, the Director must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and participate in designated on-call responsibilities, departmental coverage coordination, and onsite emergency response.

**The College**

Founded in 1830, Randolph-Macon has 1500 students and is located in Ashland, VA, a residential community 15 miles north of Richmond and 90 miles south of Washington D.C., thereby having all the benefits for its students, faculty and staff of a dynamic metropolitan area which serves as the state capitol. Over 85% of students reside on campus. For more information about the College see www.rmc.edu.

Randolph-Macon College does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status in its education or employment programs or activities.
