Title: Infrastructure Engineer TID
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose:**

Under general supervision performs responsible professional engineering review, assessment, inspection, and administrative duties. This includes reviews of design- & construction- and development proposals related to all infrastructure projects (i.e., roads, highways, bridges, utilities of all kinds, etc.) and ensuring compliance with Qatar Rail requirements, asset protection and future safeguarding. Further advises interfacing parties on NOC requirements, conditions and required actions to obtain approvals.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

The **Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the review of 3rd party applications in reference to Metro/ LRT/Long Distance project interfaces for the operational railways and future phases. The tasks will include review of plans, schematics, calculations, and specifications. The Infrastructure Engineer is required to effectively work with all involved parties, assess proposals, make recommendations, and determines comprehensive response to 3rd party requests. It includes working closely with, coordinating, and collaborating with all Qatar Rail departments, agencies/authorities, designers, and contractors internal and external to ensure conclusive and timely response. These responsibilities include attending meetings with various stakeholders.

* Provide infrastructure interface & coordination services (assistance, guidance) for the Qatar Rail schemes in relation to multiple interfaces with applicants, designers, utility agencies, contractors, stakeholders, etc.
* Review, assess, evaluate, and respond to third party requests, design-, engineering-, and construction- documents including plans, work method and specifications to ensure compliance with applicable requirements, codes, ordinances, and standards (NOC, MME, DR, RO, PTW, IPD, others); with sound understanding of utility works.
* Supporting the sr. engineer and manager as well as the relevant co-workers, departments in tasks related to approvals.
* Ensure & check completeness of documents and submissions as part of the NOC process.
* Provide and prepare interface drawings and relevant response documents.
* Participate in and create manuals, forms, procedures for processing stakeholder applications.
* Identify elements for optimizations and improvement of the department.
* Act as a link between PMC, D&B contractor and third parties.
* Attend and record meetings and act as contact person for local authorities.
* As required, inspect sites on a periodical basis to ensure conformance with permits, design specifications and adherence to quality. Provide site inspection reports.
* Resolve issues within level of authority and address modifications or changes.
* Plan, organize, track, control and evaluate the assigned functions and activities. Works proactively and responsibly.
* Maintain logs and records of work performed; prepares periodic and special reports.
* Monitor and track the TID correspondence (documentation of day-to-day work).
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**General:**

* Incorporate zero harm into staff yearly performance reviews by incorporating and taking into consideration, staff commitment to the Qatar Rail values of safety and environment.
* Commitment to the Zero Harm Ethos by leading by example and taking personal responsibility for their own health and safety and proactively ensuring that any health and safety concerns observed are raised to prevent harm.
* Support the QR Environmental program in reducing QR carbon footprint.
* Managers need to be familiar with relevant laws, regulations and standards that apply to their area of operation.
* Proactive identification of potential hazards/environmental aspects and implementing effective control measures to minimize risks.
* Liaise with HSE professionals from QSHESE Department on complex issues.
* Comply with Qatar Rail’s Company Management System requirements which covers Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, Information Security, Business continuity, Security and Emergency preparedness requiements.
* Attendance of any QSHESE Induction, training, briefing, or meeting as and when required and/or requested to.
* Be mindful that Health and Safety, Quality, Security and Environment is everyone’s responsibility and as such all-Qatar Rail employees are accountable for reporting and intervening in Health, Safety, Quality, Security and Environmental violations.
* Report all incidents and/or near misses, and/or unsafe acts or conditions and where appropriate make recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure your visitor (including contractors, PMCs) are aware of Qatar Rail premise’s emergency response plans.
* Act ethically and within Qatar Rail’s Code of Conduct.
* Undertake additional tasks as required based emerging business needs.

**Authorities:**

The position covers all interfaces through Technical Interface Department with the relevant authorities and governmental bodies. The main interface is related to authorities and stakeholders in relation to 3rd party management for the purpose of permitting within the Rail-Protection-Zone.

**Accountabilities:**

* Establishing clear line of communication with the relevant team members, departments, external stakeholders.
* Review and approve NOC-third party applications, for resign review (DR)- and road opening (RO), permit applications.
* Participate & prepare clear procedure(s) related to stakeholder management.
* Produce status- and progress reports.
* Participate in meetings, audits, presentations, workshops, and other events

**Key Interfaces:**

***Internal:***

* All Metro-, Tram lines and Long-Distance Railway.
* Departments within Program Delivery & Service Delivery
* Contractors & Joint Ventures & Consultants.
* RKH Qitarat (Service Provider)

***External:***

* Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Municipality, Public Works Authority, Civil Aviation Authority, Qatar Foundation, Private Engineering Office, Ministry of Interior (multiple departments), Supreme Committee for Delivery & Legacy, Qatar Olympic Committee, Qatar Ports Authority, Qatar Armed Forces, Hamad International Airport .
* Kahramaa Electricity & Water, Qatar Cool, Qatar Energy (Petroleum), Vodafone, QNBN, Ooredoo, MOI Police, other affected utility companies.
* Third party developers (governmental & private)
* Contractors & consultants
* Third party entities potentially affecting the Qatar Rail assets within the Rail Protection Zone.

 **Qualifications**  

* (B.Sc.) degree in civil engineering or related engineering discipline.
* A minimum of 4 years of documentable experience in fields of infrastructure/utility design and preferably large-scale projects and railway projects. GCC experience is beneficial.
* Knowledge of permitting procedures, requirements, and public approvals.
* Knowledge in infrastructure planning, design, and construction of roads, bridges, drinking water, wastewater, storm drainage, irrigation, power transmission/distribution, and preferably gas-, oil pipelines, district cooling.
* Registered as professional engineer is desirable.
* Membership with professional bodies is desirable.

 **Additional Information**

**Skills:**

* Advanced computer skills in Microsoft office including Word, Excel, Power Point and other computer programs.
* Experience with web-based collaboration technologies for project information and process management software (i.e., Aconex, QDRS / QPRO, etc.).
* Experience with AutoCAD is desired.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Applicant to be fluent in English (verbal/written); Arabic language skills are beneficial.

**Soft Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal, written communication skills and presentation skills
* Self-motivated team-player, capable of working independently & organized
* Ability to analyze situations accurately and take effective action & make critical decisions in stressful situations
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, peers, and members of the public.

Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI
Description:
**Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI**

**Company:** Ekshvaku Tech Innovations LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Office-Based  
**Experience:** 5–9 Years (Including 2+ Years of Hands-On Generative AI/LLM Development)

**About ETI**

Ekshvaku Tech Innovations (ETI) is a technology solutions and consulting company operating across the UAE and India, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, healthcare technology, insurance technology, and digital transformation.

We develop intelligent, scalable, and production-ready technology solutions for businesses across multiple industries, with a growing focus on healthcare AI, enterprise automation, and Agentic AI.

We are expanding our AI engineering capabilities and seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer who can independently design, develop, and deploy sophisticated AI-powered applications.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong Senior AI/ML Engineer with demonstrated experience building production-grade Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong software engineering fundamentals, applied machine learning expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into reliable AI systems.

This is not a research-only or prompt-engineering position.

**We are looking for an engineer who can take complete technical ownership of AI solutions, from architecture and development to deployment, optimization, monitoring, and continuous improvement.**

The selected candidate will work closely with our technical leadership and engineering teams on AI initiatives across healthcare, insurance, and enterprise technology.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Generative AI & LLM Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy applications powered by Large Language Models.
* Build solutions using commercial and open-source models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and similar technologies.
* Implement advanced prompting strategies, structured outputs, function calling, and tool integration.
* Develop and optimize LLM-powered APIs and backend services.
* Evaluate model performance, accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.

**2. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, tool usage, and executing multi-step workflows.
* Build multi-agent systems with appropriate orchestration, state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Work with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Develop intelligent workflow automation integrating AI models with enterprise systems and APIs.
* Implement appropriate safeguards for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI workflows.

**3. RAG & Knowledge Systems**

* Architect and develop production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions.
* Implement document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing.
* Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, or pgvector.
* Implement semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and context optimization.
* Develop evaluation frameworks for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and response quality.
* Improve the accuracy and reliability of AI responses while minimizing hallucinations.

**4. Applied Machine Learning**

* Develop and integrate machine learning and NLP models for classification, information extraction, summarization, prediction, and decision support.
* Work with Python-based ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and Hugging Face.
* Perform model evaluation, fine-tuning, optimization, and experimentation where appropriate.
* Apply sound statistical and machine learning principles to real-world business problems.

**5. Healthcare AI & Domain Applications**

* Contribute to the development of AI-powered clinical workflows, healthcare automation, and intelligent decision-support applications.
* Build systems capable of processing clinical documents, structured records, and medical terminology.
* Work with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR, where applicable.
* Implement clinical accuracy evaluation, evidence-grounded responses, safety guardrails, and auditability.
* Ensure secure handling of sensitive healthcare information and support HIPAA-aligned technical controls.
* Collaborate with domain specialists to improve clinical relevance and workflow reliability.

**6. Backend Engineering & System Integration**

* Develop scalable Python-based backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Design and integrate REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, databases, and external services.
* Build reliable integrations between AI systems and existing enterprise applications.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including modular architecture, testing, documentation, and code reviews.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across AI models, application services, and infrastructure.

**7. Cloud Deployment, MLOps & LLMOps**

* Deploy AI applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployment architectures.
* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and performance optimization.
* Develop automated testing and evaluation pipelines for AI applications.
* Optimize infrastructure costs, model inference latency, and overall system reliability.

**8. Technical Ownership & Collaboration**

* Independently lead technical implementation of assigned AI initiatives.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, backend engineers, QA teams, DevOps engineers, and project managers.
* Review code, mentor junior engineers, and establish engineering best practices.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure knowledge sharing across the AI engineering team.
* Engage in technical discussions and demonstrations with customers when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Programming & Backend**

* Advanced Python programming.
* FastAPI or equivalent backend frameworks.
* REST API development and asynchronous programming.
* SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals.

**Generative AI & LLMs**

* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs and open-source models.
* Prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and model evaluation.
* Experience implementing production LLM applications.

**RAG & Search**

* Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines.
* Document processing, hybrid search, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* Experience evaluating retrieval quality and reducing hallucinations.

**Agentic AI**

* Practical experience with agent frameworks or custom agent orchestration.
* Tool calling, workflow state management, multi-step execution, and human oversight.

**Machine Learning**

* Strong understanding of ML fundamentals and NLP.
* Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or Hugging Face.

**Cloud & Deployment**

* Experience with at least one major cloud platform.
* Docker, CI/CD, production deployment, logging, and monitoring.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 5–9 years of relevant software engineering and AI/ML experience.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience delivering Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
* Experience building and maintaining production AI solutions used by real customers.
* Experience in healthcare AI, clinical NLP, healthcare interoperability, or medical software applications.
* Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, or similar healthcare standards.
* Experience implementing AI safety, evaluation pipelines, audit logging, and enterprise security controls.
* Exposure to multi-agent architectures, model fine-tuning, or advanced retrieval techniques.
* Experience with enterprise customers and distributed engineering teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* **Strong Hands-On Engineering:** Able to build working AI systems rather than simply explain AI concepts.
* **Technical Independence:** Capable of owning complex solutions with minimal supervision.
* **Production Experience:** Understands how to make AI applications reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* **Problem-Solving Ability:** Can investigate and resolve complex model, retrieval, integration, and application issues.

Title: FPGA Designer
Description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

**Position Overview/Mandate:**

The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.

**Make an Impact with US:**

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.
* Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools
* Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to
* Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed
* Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation
* Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects
* Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client

**Who You are:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.
* Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.
* Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow
* Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim
* RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure
* Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes
* Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design
* Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
* Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent
* As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification – this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.

**Location and travel:** Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

This role is an evergreen position.

Annual base salary ranges from $125,000 to $160,000. The final offer within this range takes into account the variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, and with consideration to internal equity.

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching GRSP contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

**About Fidus & Why Work Here**

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Title: Process Coordinator
Description:
Role summary

The Process Coordinator leads AI-led process redesign. The role takes each business process cuts it down to the steps and fields that matter, gets the rules built into Zoho CRM, and replaces manual reports with live, AI-generated dashboards for each department and role.

The goal is simple: people put the right data in the right place at the right time, and AI turns it into decisions. Managers and coordinators should stop building reports and chasing updates by hand.

This is a process and data role, not a training role. The right person reads workflows and Zoho logic, thinks in fields and data, and is comfortable shortening a process and challenging a manager when a step adds no value.

Key responsibilities1. Process redesign

* Map each current process end to end from the CRM field list, the current SOP and how the team actually works.

* Cut steps and fields that do not feed a decision or a report.

* Set one owner and one time limit for every stage.

* Define the blocking rules the CRM must enforce (for example, no case closes without evidence; no paid job closes without an invoice number), each with a logged override.

* Link modules so data flows without re-entry (for example, case to invoice; confirmed deal to PRQ, PO and delivery).

* Write the one-page SOP for each process: stage, owner, time limit, what must exist before moving on, and what is automatic.

* Take each redesign to the department head and the fortnightly Signal review for approval; L&D then signs off the final SOP.

2. Live dashboards with AI tools

* Own the live dashboards produced through AI tools and Zoho Analytics.

* Assign department-specific and role-specific dashboards: what a sales coordinator, a manager, a division manager and a department head each need to see every day.

* Use the dashboards in real-time reviews and daily huddles so discussions run on live data, not on spreadsheets prepared the night before.

* Set up daily exception lists and weekly reports pulled automatically from the CRM and from source documents (SOPs, POs, invoices, PRQs), so nobody types the same data twice.

* Check data quality before trusting a dashboard: blocking rules come before dashboards, because AI on bad data gives confident wrong answers.

3. Less manual work

* Find every manual report, Excel tracker and repeated hand-off in each department and replace it with a dashboard or an automatic summary.

* Formally retire the old report the day the new dashboard goes live, so teams do not run both.

* Work with IT to clean up automatic tasks that a CRM rule can replace, and raise on-time completion of tasks.

* Track and report manual reporting hours removed.

4. Rollout and adoption

* Run the 8-step redesign cycle for each process: AI baseline audit, design, build, pilot, measure, fix, roll out, retire the old way.

* Write clear build requirements for IT (fields, module links, Blueprint rules, automations) and test them before go-live.

* Support DMs and department heads, who own adoption in their teams.

* Prepare and present at the fortnightly Signal review with senior leadership and IT: designs for approval, blockers and numbers against baseline.

Role requirements

* Can read a Zoho CRM module (fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflows) and explain what it does and where it breaks.

* Can take a field list and an SOP and produce a shorter, rule-based process on paper within a day.

* Uses AI tools daily for analysis, summaries and dashboards, and knows how to check their output.

* Comfortable telling a senior manager that a step or a report should go, and backing it with data.

* Measures improvement as numbers against a baseline, not opinions.

* Leads change across departments and holds a redesign under challenge from senior managers, with the Sponsor's backing.

* Fluent written and spoken English; Arabic or Hindi is a plus.

Education

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Operations Management, Business Analytics or a related field.

Industry experience

* **4-6 years** in process improvement, business analysis, CRM operations or sales/service operations.

* At least **2 years hands-on with a CRM**, ideally Zoho CRM (Salesforce or Dynamics also acceptable).

* Experience in **B2B trading, industrial equipment, distribution or after-sales service**, preferably in the UAE or GCC.

* Has led at least one process redesign or CRM rollout from mapping to go-live, with measurable results.

* Experience building or running management dashboards that replaced manual reports.

**Required skills**

Technical

* Zoho CRM: modules, fields, layouts, Blueprints, workflow rules, reports

* Dashboards and BI: Zoho Analytics, Power BI or similar

* AI tools for analysis and reporting (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), including pulling data from documents and CRM exports

* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, data cleaning)

* Process mapping (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro or BPMN tools)

* Basic understanding of automations and integrations (Deluge, APIs, Zapier) is a plus

Analytical

* Reads data and fields to find where a process breaks

* Builds a baseline and measures change against it

* Spots bad data and its root cause before it reaches a dashboard

* Turns findings into a short, clear decision for a manager

Behavioural

* Simplifier: removes steps instead of adding them

* Confident with senior managers; willing to challenge

* Structured and finishes what it starts: one process at a time, closed properly

* Clear writer: one-page SOPs, short build specs, plain reports

* Patient with teams during change; firm on the rules

Pay: AED3,000.00 - AED4,500.00 per month

Title: Field CISO
Description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Our Team's Vision:**
----------------------

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience.

**Our Values**
==============

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

* **Bring Your Best:** We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.
* **Build Trust:** We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.
* **Seek Truth:** We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.
* **Onwards Together:** We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.
* **Leverage Differences:** We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Field CISO, Zero Trust Segmentation is a newly created, specialized role within the Global Solutions Engineering team, chartered to deepen Illumio’s credibility and category leadership within the CISO community. This role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community: we are looking for a security executive — a current or former CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security leader — who brings a proven balance of business acumen, technical depth, and operational experience running a security program, rather than a traditional pre-sales background. This is a hybrid role by design: half executive advisor and evangelist, half hands-on architect.

As Field CISO, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism**

* Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.
* Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.
* Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.
* Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

**Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership**

* Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.
* Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.
* Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.
* Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

**Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution**

* Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.
* Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.
* Act as the final technical and executive escalation point for deals across regions, ensuring a consistent, credible narrative in front of customers.

**Team Enablement & Capability Building**

* Design and deliver training curriculum and certification paths for the global SE team.
* Build battlecards, FAQs, and RFP response libraries, keeping the team current against an evolving competitive landscape.
* Mentor SE Leads and SEs on segmentation and breach containment concepts, positioning, and objection handling — bringing an operator’s perspective on how real security teams evaluate and adopt these solutions.

**Product & Market Feedback Loop**

* Serve as a structured, credible voice of the field back to Product Management on roadmap priorities, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence.
* Track and analyze the competitive landscape across microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud detection and response, including new entrants and adjacent incumbents extending into the space.

**Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security executive (VP/Director of Information Security) is required — this role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community to bring firsthand business, technical, and operational credibility to the field.
* 10+ years of experience leading enterprise security programs, with direct, hands-on exposure to network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, incident response and breach containment, or cloud security.
* Demonstrated ability to speak credibly to both engineering and executive/board audiences translating technical risk into business terms and back again.
* Demonstrated track record as an external-facing voice: conference speaking, analyst engagement, published thought leadership, or peer-community leadership (e.g., CISO forums, ISACs).
* Proven hands-on architecture and build capability — this is not a strategy-only role; the person must be able to personally build and demo complex technical environments.
* Demonstrated experience engaging CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders, ideally as a former peer, on strategic, multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive narrative.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% for customer, analyst, and industry engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior title of CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO, or VP/Director of Information Security at an enterprise or mid-market organization.
* Direct operational experience running a segmentation, Zero Trust, or breach containment program.
* Experience with microsegmentation, CNAPP, cloud security posture management, or hybrid cloud detection and response tooling.
* Existing relationships with analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, and others) covering network security, Zero Trust, or security operations.
* Experience integrating or building go-to-market plans around a new or acquired product line.
* Published thought leadership — blogs, whitepapers, podcasts, or conference talks — on breach containment, Zero Trust, or cyber resilience.
* Familiarity with the broader Illumio platform: Illumio Segmentation, Illumio Insights, container/Kubernetes segmentation, OT/ICS environments, and hybrid cloud architectures.

**Our Commitment**

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

*All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*

*For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

Title: AI & Analytics - AI Architect - Freelance - Dubai
Description:

Infomineo is a pioneering global AI-enhanced research company that transforms how businesses access, analyze, and act on critical intelligence. We’ve evolved from traditional business research outsourcing to become the strategic partner that combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with deep human expertise. We offer 3 services to our global clients (leading consulting companies, Fortune 500 companies, and government entities): AI and Data Advisory, Next-Gen Insights and Resource Scaling. * 350+ industry experts spread across 5 offices (Cairo, Casablanca, Mexico City, Dubai, Barcelona).

Ready to kick start your career with us?

**About this role**

This role will give you the opportunity to design and shape the technical foundation of our Analytics & AI practice, working on high-impact client engagements across industries. As our Analytics & AI Architect, you will sit at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, data science, and AI — defining the standards, frameworks, and architectures that our teams build upon.

**What will you do?**

Lead the technical architecture of Data, Analytics and AI solutions for our clients, covering the full lifecycle from design to deployment:

**ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN**

* Design end-to-end data architectures: data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, and streaming pipelines.
* Define standards for data modeling, storage, ingestion, and transformation across client engagements.
* Architect MLOps and AI deployment infrastructure (model registries, CI/CD for ML, monitoring).
* Lead technical decisions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and open-source tooling.

**TEAM ENABLEMENT**

* Define best practices and reusable frameworks for data engineers, analysts, and data scientists.
* Act as a technical mentor and reviewer for cross-functional project teams.
* Bridge the gap between data analysts, data engineers, and AI/ML engineers on complex projects.
* Contribute to internal knowledge base, toolkits, and delivery accelerators.

**CLIENT ENGAGEMENT**

* Lead architecture workshops and discovery sessions with client stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, robust technical blueprints.
* Present architecture decisions to both technical teams and executive audiences.
* Support pre-sales and proposal efforts with technical scoping and solution design.

**OTHER**

* Provide internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions with the team.
* Support the Head of Practice on business development and internal capability initiatives.

**Who are you?**

**EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
* Full proficiency in English + 1 additional language (French, Arabic, Spanish, German...).
* 6+ years of technical experience in data architecture or a closely related field.
* Proven track record in a consulting or multi-client services environment.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**DATA ARCHITECTURE & PLATFORMS**

* Proven hands-on experience designing large-scale data platforms: data lake, lakehouse, or warehouse architectures (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Redshift).
* Strong command of SQL and at least one of Python, Scala, or Spark for data processing and transformation.
* Experience with Big Data ecosystems: Hadoop, Spark, PySpark, Hive, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with streaming and real-time architectures (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).

**AI & ML INFRASTRUCTURE**

* Proven hands-on experience with ML lifecycle tooling: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, or equivalent.
* Experience architecting MLOps pipelines: model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring and drift detection.
* Exposure to GenAI and LLM integration patterns (RAG architectures, vector databases, prompt pipelines).

**DATA ENGINEERING & DEPLOYMENT**

* Proven hands-on experience with orchestration and transformation tools: Airflow, dbt, or equivalent.
* Proven hands-on experience with container technologies: Docker, Kubernetes.
* Proven hands-on experience with versioning software: Git, GitHub, GitLab.
* Proven hands-on experience deploying solutions in cloud ecosystems: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

**GOVERNANCE & STANDARDS**

* Knowledge of data governance frameworks: data catalogs, lineage tracking, access control, and data quality management.
* Exposure to BI and data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) and semantic layer design.

**INTERPERSONAL SKILLS**

* Ability to step back, analyze complex problems, define architectural options, and drive decisions.
* Strong ability to work and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear business implications.
* High autonomy, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.

**What we offer**

* A competitive salary.
* A great working environment.
* A steep learning curve with interesting and diverse topics to work on.
* A healthy work-life balance.
* Health insurance benefits.

**Equal opportunity employer**

Infomineo is an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any sort of discrimination (based on color, race, sex, sexual orientation, religion, national origin or any other attributes) in all aspects of employment (recruiting, hiring, wages and salary, promotions, benefits, training and job termination).

If you believe you match our requirements and values, we would be happy to hear from you. Visit our website to know more about us, our services and company culture.

Title: Document Controller - KSA National
Description:
Overview:

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.

As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.

We invite you to join us. Why?

When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.

The **Document Controller** is a critical member of the Site Supervision team responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing a robust, efficient, and fully auditable document control system throughout the construction and Defects Liability Period of the project.

You will ensure all technical submissions, correspondence, records, reports, and project documentation are properly received, tracked, distributed, archived, and retrieved in accordance with the project's procedures, the Service Order requirements, and best industry practices (including EDMS/Aconex). Your role is essential for maintaining project compliance, supporting timely technical reviews, and facilitating successful project handover.

Responsibilities:

Our newest opportunity is for a talented Document Controller to join our team, based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

We envisage success in this role to include;

* Establishing and maintaining a comprehensive Document Control System for the duration of the project, including the construction phase and 12-month Defects Liability Period.
* Implementing and managing the use of the approved Electronic Document Management System (EDMS – e.g., Aconex or equivalent) for all project documentation.
* Developing and enforcing standard document numbering, filing, and transmittal procedures in line with the client's and Consultant requirements.
* Receiving, logging, and distributing all Contractor submissions including Shop Drawings, Material Approval Requests (MARs), Method Statements, Technical Specifications, Calculations, RFIs, As-Built Drawings, O&M Manuals, and other deliverables.
* Maintaining a live, up-to-date tracker of all submissions with clear status (Received, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, Revised, etc.).
* Ensuring timely return of reviewed documents with Comment Review Sheets (CRS) and tracking open/close status of comments.
* Controlling all incoming and outgoing project correspondence, instructions, notices, and reports between the Consultant, Client, Contractor, and other stakeholders.
* Preparing and issuing formal transmittals and maintaining accurate records of all communications.
* Supporting the team in the preparation and compilation of Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Reports.
* Ensuring all quality-related documentation (ITPs, MIRs, WIRs, inspection records, test results, NCRs, etc.) is properly filed and easily retrievable.
* Supporting the compilation of the Project Completion Dossier and Handover Package in accordance with the client's Asset Completion and Handover Procedure (including Appendix A deliverables).
* Maintaining records for audit, claims, variations, and regulatory compliance purposes.
* Providing accurate document status updates for Weekly and Monthly Progress Meetings.
* Preparing document control metrics and reports as required by the Senior Project Manager/Project Director.
* Archiving all project records in a structured, secure, and indexed manner at project close-out.
* Providing training and guidance to the supervision team on document control procedures and EDMS usage.
* Coordinating with discipline leads (Construction Managers, Inspectors, HSE, etc.) to ensure timely review and response to submissions.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 5 years work experience partnered with a Diploma or Bachelor degree in Business Administration.

**This position is for KSA Nationals only.**

* **Experience:** Minimum **5 years** of relevant Document Control experience on major construction projects (as per Service Order requirements),
* Proven experience with EDMS platforms (Aconex, SharePoint, or equivalent).
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and construction project documentation workflows.

**Key Competencies**

* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (Arabic is an advantage).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and EDMS software.
* Ability to work independently and manage high volumes of documentation under pressure.
* Understanding of construction processes, shop drawings, technical submissions, and quality records.
* Commitment to confidentiality and data integrity.

KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.

We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

Title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
Description:
**Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)**

**Platform & Reliability Engineering**

Location:
**Dubai, UAE**
|Function:
**Engineering**
| Type:
**Full-Time**
| Experience:
**7–10 years**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

**Application stack**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

**Data stores**

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

**Messaging**

Kafka

**Cloud**

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

**Containers**

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

**IaC**

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

**CI/CD**

Bitbucket Pipelines

**Observability**

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

**Security**

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

**Reliability**

SLOs & error budgets, k6, Chaos Mesh, OpenCost

**OUR VALUES**

At Lulu, our values aren't wall decorations — they guide how we work, hire, and grow.

**Be Customer Obsessed —**
Every decision in service of the customer's success.

**Speak & Act Courageously —**
Challenge the status quo, take calculated risks, and advocate for new ideas.

**Take Extreme Ownership —**
Nothing is someone else's problem. Uphold excellence and accountability.

**Learn Voraciously —**
Growth mindset, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Move with Focus & Urgency —**
Identify the highest-impact work and move fast.

**Win as One Team —**
Celebrate wins, lend a hand, and invest in each other's growth.

*We believe great engineering is about judgment, ownership, and craft — not just code.*

*If that resonates, we would love to hear from you.*

The End-to-End Service Order Orchestration SME will provide domain expertise for the design, customization, validation, and rollout of the client service order management and orchestration capability. The role ensures that the platform supports the complete lifecycle of service requests, order creation, approvals, assignments, fulfillment, field execution, status tracking, closure, and reporting. * Define and validate the end-to-end service order lifecycle, including request intake, order creation, feasibility assessment, approvals, assignment, fulfillment, completion, and closure processes.

* Support training activities, change management initiatives, user adoption, and operational readiness for service order management users.

Title: Senior Contract Administrator
Description:
Senior Contract Administrator (SCA)

Position Type:  
Independent Contractor (Incorporated)

Contract Duration:  
One (1) year

Location:  
5160 Yonge Street, North York, Ontario, Canada. Hybrid work arrangement, with a minimum of two (2) days per week in the TTC office or on-site and the remaining days remotely, subject to hiring manager approval. Remote work must be performed within Ontario. Candidates may also be required to attend meetings at various TTC locations across the Greater Toronto Area.

Work Schedule:  
Up to 35 hours per week, seven (7) hours per day, during TTC business hours. Work may begin no earlier than 7:00 a.m. Candidates must be able to travel to the TTC office and attend on-site meetings as required.

Remuneration:  
Competitive hourly rate

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced Senior Contract Administrators to support the Toronto Transit Commission’s (TTC) Commercial Management Department. The successful candidates will provide professional contract administration and commercial management services, with a focus on post-award activities involving construction contracts and design, engineering, and professional service contracts.

The role involves reviewing and interpreting contractual requirements, managing contract changes and claims, negotiating commercial matters, monitoring contract performance, administering payment processes, and maintaining accurate contract records. The successful candidates will work closely with project delivery teams, contractors, consultants, legal representatives, and other internal stakeholders to ensure contractual obligations are met, commercial risks are managed, and TTC’s interests are protected.

Key Responsibilities

1. Contract Administration and Management

* Coordinate and administer post-award contract activities for construction, design, engineering, and professional service contracts.
* Review, interpret, and analyse contract documents, specifications, terms, and conditions to ensure consistent application of contractual requirements.
* Provide contract administration support to project delivery teams and respond to assigned requests and tasks.
* Ensure that contractual strategies and individual clauses are appropriately applied to reduce risk and protect the TTC’s interests.
* Administer contracts throughout their lifecycle, from post-award activities through to final close-out.

2. Contract Review and Compliance

* Review contractor and consultant submissions, including work plans, task and work assignments, contract changes, amendments, invoices, contractual notices, claim notices, statements, and other correspondence.

* Identify contractual inconsistencies, irregularities, performance concerns, and other issues requiring resolution.
* Provide recommendations and advice to project teams and management on contractual matters.

3. Commercial Negotiations and Contract Changes

* Lead and support commercial negotiations involving contract rates, work plans, assignments, amendments, changes, claims, unit-price settlements, and other contractual matters.
* Evaluate and negotiate commercial aspects of work plan submissions and process work plan or assignment releases.
* Administer the full lifecycle of contract changes, amendments, claims, and change directives.
* Evaluate contractual entitlement, scope, pricing, schedules, labour, material, and equipment costs.
* Prepare independent cost estimates and analyses to support the assessment and negotiation of proposed changes and claims.
* Chair negotiations with contractors to establish acceptable settlements on pricing and contractual terms.
* Negotiate final settlement of quantities for unit-price contracts and recommend commercially sound agreements that provide fair market value and protect TTC’s interests.

4. Claims Management and Risk Mitigation

* Review and assess contractor claims, notices, and supporting documentation.
* Develop and implement claims avoidance and mitigation strategies.
* Identify and evaluate commercial, contractual, financial, and project delivery risks.
* Support the resolution of complex contractual matters, including contractor performance issues and disputes.
* Engage internal legal representatives when necessary to support negotiations, resolution of contractual matters, and enforcement of contractual obligations.
* Support the application of contractual penalty clauses and liquidated damages where applicable.
* Escalate complex or high-profile contractual issues to the Commercial Manager and/or Director.

5. Payment Administration and Financial Management

* Oversee and administer payment processes in accordance with approved contract price breakdowns and contractual requirements.
* Review and verify vendor invoices against applicable contract payment terms.
* Assess payment-related matters, including statutory holdbacks under the Construction Lien Act, final payments, set-off charges, off-site inventory payments, and liquidated damages.
* Prepare cost estimates for materials, labour, and equipment.
* Analyse production and construction schedules when evaluating contractor change requests, claims, and proposed amendments.
* Monitor contract expenditures, allowances, contingencies, forecasts, and other financial commitments.

6. Contract Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Monitor assigned contracts, contractor performance, progress, expenditures, and commercial risks.
* Prepare and provide contract status reports, analyses, and recommendations to management and project delivery teams.
* Prepare Performance Review Reports and participate in meetings concerning unsatisfactory performance assessments.
* Monitor contract performance indicators and ensure assigned performance KPIs and targets are achieved.
* Provide information and recommendations to support effective financial, contractual, and project-related decision-making.

7. Contract Documentation and Records Management

* Maintain accurate and complete contract administration records throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Manage documentation relating to work plan releases, contract amendments, changes, change directives, payment certificates, notices, correspondence, and close-out activities.
* Maintain records within the Contract Management System and other relevant corporate systems.
* Process Requests for Quotes, contract amendments, changes, and change directives.
* Review and provide input into the development of Purchase Authorization Amendment Board Reports.
* Prepare and process contract close-out documentation.

* Attend project progress meetings, engineering review meetings, and other meetings as required.
* Collaborate with project delivery teams, contractors, consultants, legal representatives, and internal stakeholders to resolve contractual and commercial matters.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to the design, planning, and development of contract management systems, standards, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve contract administration processes, procedures, and controls.
* Apply quality assurance and quality control principles to support effective contract management practices.

Title: Land Surveyor
Description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

**1. Job Purpose**
------------------

To carry out all surveying, setting-out verification, and dimensional control activities ensuring that the Contractor's setting-out, levels, alignments, and as-built records comply with the approved IFC drawings, project specifications, and the requirements of the Client and relevant Dubai authorities (DM, RTA, DEWA). The Land Surveyor provides the Resident Engineer with independent verification of all survey-related works and ensures full traceability to the Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) coordinate system and DMD (Dubai Municipality Datum) vertical datum.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

**2.1 Survey Control & Datum**

* Establish, verify, and maintain primary and secondary survey control networks on site, tied to DLTM and DMD via Dubai Municipality benchmarks.
* Carry out periodic verification of control stations to confirm stability and accuracy.
* Maintain the Project Control Register, including coordinates, elevations, descriptions, and check records.
* Verify the Contractor's survey control submissions and recommend approval to the Resident Engineer.

**2.2 Setting-Out Verification**

* Independently check the Contractor's setting-out of roads, bridges, tunnels, structures, drainage, and utility corridors against approved IFC drawings.
* Verify horizontal alignment, vertical alignment, cross-sections, super-elevation, gradients, and chainages.
* Sign off setting-out check sheets prior to commencement of works and maintain the setting-Out Register.
* Issue Survey Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) where setting out does not comply with approved drawings or tolerances.

**2.3 Roadworks Surveying**

* Verify levels and lines for subgrade, subbase, aggregate base course (ABC), and asphalt layers (binder and wearing course).
* Check kerbs, gullies, channels, manhole covers, road markings, and signage positions.
* Confirm camber, crossfall, super-elevation transitions, and gradient compliance with approved geometric design.
* Carry out asphalt level checks before and after paving to verify thickness compliance.

**2.4 Bridges & Structures**

* Verify setting-out and levels for piles, pile caps, piers, abutments, bearings, girders, deck slabs, parapets, and expansion joints.
* Check geometric control of formwork, falsework, and reinforcement positioning.
* Carry out monitoring surveys for movement, settlement, and deflection of structures during and after construction.
* Verify final geometry of bridge decks, including camber, alignment, and joint positions.

**2.5 Tunnels**

* Verify tunnel alignment control, including horizontal and vertical setting-out of the tunnel axis.
* Check setting-out for segmental linings, cross-passages, shafts, portals, and tunnel finishes.
* Carry out convergence and settlement monitoring of tunnel sections and surrounding structures.
* Coordinate with the Contractor's tunnel survey team on TBM guidance and as-built tunnel geometry.

**2.6 Infrastructure Utilities**

* Verify setting-out of water, sewerage, irrigation, district cooling, telecom, and electrical networks.
* Check trench alignment, invert levels, gradients, and connection points to existing utilities.
* Confirm chamber, manhole, and valve positions and levels.
* Coordinate with DEWA, DM Sewerage, Etisalat/du, and Empower surveyors during joint surveys and tie-ins.

**2.7 Topographic & Pre-Construction Surveys**

* Witness and verify topographic surveys, pre-construction condition surveys, and existing utility surveys carried out by the Contractor.
* Check existing levels, ground conditions, and surface features against design assumptions.
* Identify and report any discrepancies between design and existing site conditions to the Resident Engineer.

**2.8 Quantity Verification Support**

* Carry out joint surveys with the Contractor and Quantity Surveyor for measurement of earthworks (cut/fill), excavation, backfill, and pavement layers.
* Prepare cross-sections, longitudinal sections, and volume calculations using survey software (Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Trimble Business Center).
* Support the Quantity Surveyor with survey-based quantity verification for interim payment applications.

**2.9 As-Built Surveys & Records**

* Verify the Contractor's as-built surveys for all completed works and ensure compliance with project specifications and DM/RTA submission requirements.
* Check accuracy, completeness, and format of as-built drawings prior to recommendation for approval.
* Maintain a comprehensive As-Built Survey Register and ensure traceability to hand over documentation.

**2.10 Instruments & Calibration**

* Maintain Consultant's survey instruments (Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, automatic and digital levels, prisms, and accessories) in good working order.
* Verify that all Contractor's survey instruments are calibrated by accredited laboratories with valid certificates.
* Maintain a Calibration Register for all survey equipment used on the project.

**2.11 Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain comprehensive survey records: control sheets, setting out check sheets, level books, monitoring records, NCRs, and as-built data.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly survey activity reports for the Resident Engineer.
* Support authority audits and submissions to DM, RTA, and DEWA with verified survey data.

**2.12 Coordination & Reporting**

* Report directly to the Resident Engineer on all survey-related matters.
* Coordinate with Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and team.
* Attend technical meetings, progress reviews, and joint surveys with authorities.

**3. Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Education:** B.Sc. in Surveying / Geomatics / Civil Engineering, or a recognized Diploma in Land Surveying with relevant professional experience.
* **Experience:** Minimum 10 years' experience in land surveying on construction projects, with at least 7 years on major infrastructure projects (roads, bridges, tunnels, utilities) and a minimum of 3 years in the UAE/GCC.
* **Certifications:** Dubai Municipality / RTA approval as Land Surveyor is highly preferred.
* **Knowledge:** Dubai Local Transverse Mercator (DLTM) projection, DMD vertical datum, DM and RTA survey specifications, geometric design standards, and infrastructure construction tolerances.
* **Skills:** Expert use of Total Stations, GNSS/RTK GPS, digital levels, and 3D laser scanners. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D. Good technical report writing, attention to detail, and effective communication.

**4. Reporting Line**
---------------------

The Land Surveyor reports directly to the Resident Engineer and works in close coordination with the Assistant Resident Engineer, Site Engineers, Materials Engineer, Quantity Surveyor, and the Contractor's Survey Manager and survey team.
